* As a Senior Data Engineer, you will be involved in data Lakehouse development including requirements gathering, database modeling, ETL job design \& development, and dashboard/report development activities.
* You will be working with the Customer Experience team to build and enhance a cloud\-based warehouse of operational data to drive analytics.
* You will be responsible for developing ETL/data pipelines using Talend, SQL, and Python, and ingesting data from various external sources into large MPP data warehouses such as Azure Synapse, Hive, Snowflake, or similar platforms.
* You will frequently conduct data analysis, ingest data from various internal and external sources, write advanced SQL queries, and optimize data storage needed by business and executive operations.
* You will partner with business stakeholders to analyze operational data, investigate trends, answer ad hoc business questions, and provide data\-driven recommendations that support strategic and operational decision\-making.
* You will perform exploratory data analysis, validate data quality, identify anomalies, reconcile data across multiple sources, and translate business requirements into SQL\-based analyses and actionable insights.
* You will develop complex SQL queries to extract, profile, reconcile, and analyze large datasets, helping stakeholders understand business performance, customer behavior, operational metrics, and data quality issues.
* You will enable daily business activities by providing the foundation for all federated querying and analysis produced by the BI and Data Science teams.
* You will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Business Analysts, BI Developers, and Data Scientists to ensure data is accurate, reliable, and optimized for reporting, advanced analytics, and machine learning initiatives.
* You will have the opportunity to work with modern data stack components and continuously grow by learning new tools and technologies in a collaborative, data\-driven environment.



**Position Requirements** 
  
 



**Basic Qualifications** 
  
 


* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Science.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in ETL development and coding, including validation of complex data mappings.
* Hands\-on experience with ETL Tool Talend (minimum 5 years).
* Proficient in SQL with at least 8 years of experience developing complex SQL queries for data validation, troubleshooting, and business analysis.
* Experience in Python for data processing and transformation tasks.
* Strong experience with data warehouse databases such as Azure Synapse, Hive, Snowflake, SQL Server, or Redshift.
* Experience and knowledge in ingesting data from various external sources is a must\-have.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to analyze large datasets and translate findings into meaningful business insights.
* Experience performing data profiling, data quality analysis, data reconciliation, and root cause analysis using SQL.
* Experience working with business stakeholders to understand analytical requirements and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Experience working with cloud\-based data platforms.



**Preferred Qualifications** 
  
 


* Exposure to Databricks for big data processing and orchestration.
* Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Familiarity with Agile Scrum development methodologies.
* Experience working in or exposure to Data Science, Machine Learning, or Generative AI\-based projects.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About OnePay**
 OnePay is the consumer fintech trusted by millions of Americans to make money better.
   

  

 Our financial system is broken. High fees, low rates, and too few ways to actually grow your money. We’re fixing it. And we’re moving fast.
   

  

 We’re an all\-in\-one financial services platform that brings together banking, high\-yield savings, credit cards, point\-of\-sale lending, investing, and crypto in one place. We also partner with employers, HCM providers, gig platforms, and others to deliver embedded financial services to millions of employees and frontline workers.
   

  

 We’re backed by Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, and Ribbit Capital, one of fintech’s most respected investors, giving us rare scale, distribution, and the opportunity to build something truly category\-defining.
   

  

 But What Really Sets OnePay Apart Is How We Move. Our Customers Don’t Have Time To Wait… And Neither Do We. This Place Moves Fast, And We’re Looking For People Who Are
   

  

* Ready to run
* Hungry and driven by urgency
* Exceptional at what they do, with low ego
* Comfortable operating in motion


**The Role**
 As a data engineer, your mandate is to build the data transformation pipelines \& reporting infrastructure that serve our members and run our company. This role will impact OnePay’s vision by writing, reviewing, and shipping code and collaborating with others across the company. You will work closely across the Engineering, Product, Compliance and Customer Support team(s) working with stakeholders as highly technical, communicative, and emotionally intelligent partners. This role reports to the Manager, Data Engineering.
   

  

**This Role Is Responsible For**
* Building and maintaining OnePay's data infrastructure.
* Developing and owning OnePay's streaming data transformation pipeline.
* Managing and supporting reporting and analytics tools.
* Collaborating closely with our Data Analysts and Data Scientists.
* Tracking and defining metrics around performance.
* Additional duties as assigned by your manager.


**You Bring**
* 5 \+ years of experience
* Experience in Databricks, Apache Spark, Scala, Python, SQL.
* Experience designing and implementing low latency data pipelines using Spark structured streaming.
* Experience optimizing SQL queries and lake / warehouse data structures.
* Cost\-conscience creative problem solving.
* Proficient in AWS cloud services and technologies.
* Experience building, shipping — and growing — non\-trivial products \& services.
* Passion for your craft, people, and our mission. You value quality across code, communication, and culture.
* A desire to keep growing your skills, and an ability to learn quickly. We hire for slope, not just y\-intercept.


**Tools We Use**
 We use Node and TypeScript on the server, leveraging the NestJS framework within a microservice\-oriented architecture running on Kubernetes and AWS. On the client side, we build and ship product features for iOS, Android, and web platforms using React Native. We also embrace AI\-assisted development, so engineers have their choice of Claude Code or Cursor to fit their workflow. While you don't need experience with our exact stack, familiarity with modern software engineering practices will help you ramp up quickly.
   

  

 What We Offer
   

  

* Competitive salary, stock options, and benefits from Day 1
* Comprehensive health insurance coverage (health insurance, accident and disability insurance, term life insurance), including mental health support and wellness programs
* Hybrid work model (Bengaluru office three days a week), various time off programs (vacation, sick, other paid leaves, and paid regional holidays)
* Monthly transport and work\-from\-home allowances
* A high\-growth, mission\-driven, inclusive culture where your work has real impact


 Standard Interview Process
   

  

* Initial Interview with Talent Partner
* Technical or Hiring Manager Interview
* Team Interview
* Executive Interview
* Offer!


 Equal Employment Opportunity
   

  

 To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real\-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us at talent@onepay.com.

title: Solution Category Owner – Consultation Solutions
description:
**ZEISS in India**

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports \& Cine Optics.


ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R\&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales \& Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200\+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.


Further information at ZEISS India .


The role encompasses a broad range of responsibilities aimed at delivering innovative, high\-quality software consultation solutions across hardware, software, and digital platforms:


**Portfolio Strategy \& Category Ownership in alignment with overall department structure**

* Define and own the multi\-year Consultations strategy, aligned with the company's vision care growth objectives and competitive positioning, explicitly covering In\-Store Consultation categories.
* Establish and maintain the category roadmap, covering device\-agnostic consultation workflows that guide ECPs from anamnesis and measurement inputs to the appropriate consultation pathway and product recommendation, independent of the devices connected to the digital connectivity platform.
* Build on continuous market analysis, competitive benchmarking, and voice\-of\-customer research with ECPs and retail chains to identify white spaces, emerging technology trends, portfolio gaps and unmet needs in guided, measurement\-driven consultation workflows.

**Product development oversight in alignment with overall department structure**

* Provide indirect leadership to product development teams, aligning development priorities with category strategy and working closely with the Product Development team to reinforce the product vision, ensuring portfolio investments deliver competitive, market\-ready solutions.
* Own the business requirements and commercial specifications that inform product development and engineering; represent the market perspective throughout the development lifecycle (concept through launch), ensuring clear and testable requirements are defined in close collaboration with Product Owners.
* Define business and workflow requirements that enable consultation guidance based on consumer anamnesis, device\-sourced measurement data and workflow stage, ensuring the solution can recommend the right consultation path regardless of the measurement devices used in the store.
* Serve as senior sponsor for key development programs within the refraction category, ensuring cross\-functional alignment and timely escalation of risks.
* Champion design\-for\-configurability, total cost of ownership, and regulatory strategy considerations from the earliest stages of development.
* Ensure products are designed for serviceability (ease to install, configure, upgrade), partnering with Service/Operations to incorporate field feedback early.
* Ensure products are designed to be secure, including cyber security and data privacy requirements, working with relevant security/compliance stakeholders across the lifecycle.

**Product lifecycle management in alignment with overall department structure**

* Own the full device lifecycle from concept and market entry through growth, maturity, and end\-of\-life planning.
* Define launch strategies in partnership with Marketing, Sales, and regional teams, including go\-to\-market approach, pricing, positioning, and key opinion leader engagement.
* Monitor post\-launch performance against defined KPIs (revenue, margin, market share, customer satisfaction) and drive corrective actions where needed.
* Continuously validate post\-launch whether the solution improves ECP guidance quality, consultation pathway selection, workflow consistency and consumer conversion across different device setups and store environments.
* Plan and execute product refresh, extension, and phase\-out decisions, managing inventory implications in conjunction with Supply Chain and Finance.

**Team leadership \& people management**

* Directly recruit, develop, and manage a team of Product Managers responsible for product implementation across geographies and customer segments.
* Set clear objectives, provide regular feedback, and build individual development plans that grow product management capability within the team.
* Foster a high\-performance culture grounded in customer focus, analytical rigor, and cross\-functional collaboration.
* Act as an indirect leader and integrating force for the extended cross\-functional team – including product development engineers, supply chain managers, regulatory specialists, and clinical affairs – ensuring shared ownership of category outcomes.

**Cross\-functional collaboration \& stakeholder management**

* Serve as the primary interface between the Consultations category and global functions including Product Development, Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Affairs, Marketing, and Sales.
* Partner with device, connectivity platform, clinical, workflow and UX stakeholders to ensure measurement data from different in\-store devices can be translated into meaningful consultation guidance for ECPs.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs to ensure all Consultation Software Solutions in the portfolio are developed and maintained in compliance with applicable requirements (FDA, EU MDR, ISO 10937, and relevant national standards).
* Collaborate with Clinical Affairs to define clinical evidence requirements and support generation of data that strengthens the clinical and commercial position of the portfolio.
* Present category strategy, portfolio performance, and investment cases to executive leadership and governance bodies.

**Education / Professional Certification**

Preferred level of education (unskilled/vocational training/bachelor/university degree); preferred Institutes if any.


* Degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, or a related technical/scientific discipline; MBA or equivalent business qualification is an advantage.

**Experience**

* 7\- 10 years of progressive experience in product management, portfolio management, or category leadership within medical/ophthalmic devices or vision care.
* Proven track record owning and growing a product portfolio across the full lifecycle (sourcing, development oversight, launch and lifecycle optimization).
* Leadership experience managing Product Managers and influencing senior stakeholders in a global matrix organization.

title: Principal Engineer, Systems
description:
Vantive is a vital organ therapy company on a mission to extend lives and expand possibilities for patients and care teams everywhere. For 70 years, our team has driven meaningful innovations in kidney care. As we build on our legacy, we are deepening our commitment to elevating the dialysis experience through digital solutions and advanced services, while looking beyond kidney care and investing in transforming vital organ therapies. Greater flexibility and efficiency in therapy administration for care teams, and longer, fuller lives for patients— that is what Vantive aspires to deliver.


We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us. At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us is driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us in advancing our mission to extend lives and expand possibilities.


Vantive: A New Company Built on Our Legacy


Since last year, Baxter has been on a journey to separate our Kidney Care segment into a standalone company. Vantive\* will build on our nearly 70\-year legacy in acute therapies and home and in\-center dialysis to provide best\-in\-class care to the people we serve. We believe Vantive will not only build our leadership in the kidney care space, it will also offer meaningful work to those who join us.

  

 At Vantive, you will become part of a community of people who are focused, courageous and don’t settle for the mediocre. Each of us are driven to help improve patients’ lives worldwide. Join us as we revolutionize kidney care and other vital organ support.

 **JOB TITLE: Principal Engineer, Systems (Model based development)**

**Your role :**


As a MDB leader for the Peritoneal dialysis systems the candidate will lead the development of embedded control software for complex electromechanical medical devices using a Model‑Based Design (MBD) approach. In this role, you will lead the design, simulation, and implementation of control algorithms using MATLAB/Simulink, ensuring robust system behavior and seamless integration with hardware components.


You will be responsible for generating high‑quality embedded code through automated workflows, ensuring compliance with relevant software and medical device standards such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, IEC 60601, and internal quality processes. Working within the Systems Engineering team and collaborating closely with Software, Hardware, V\&V, Quality, Regulatory, and Manufacturing groups, you will help translate system‑level requirements into validated models and embedded implementations.


The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, deep experience in MBD workflows, and a solid understanding of real‑time embedded systems. You demonstrate leadership in guiding technical decisions, ensuring design traceability, performing system analysis, managing interfaces, and delivering solutions that support safe, reliable, and innovative medical devices.

 **Job description :**


As a MDB leader for the Peritoneal dialysis systems the candidate will lead all the MBD activities collaborating with the cross functional teams to deliver the embedded code while meeting all the medical device regulations and standards with Aqueduct as the leading project.

* Define and own the MBD framework, methodology, and governance for MATLAB/Simulink, State flow, and Embedded Coder.
* Create system‑level models (plant \+ controller) for electro‑mechanical behaviors—motors/actuators, power stages, sensors, safety interlocks, calibration, and diagnostics.
* Define modeling guidelines, libraries, and reference architectures to maximize reuse, traceability, and testability.

Translate system requirements into executable models; maintain end‑to‑end traceability (DOORS Simulink Requirements tests* code).
* Decompose control strategies and safety requirements into model components, interfaces, and state machines.
* Lead FMEA /Risk analysis (ISO 14971\) and ensure design mitigations are implemented and verified in models.
* Set standards for auto‑code generation (Embedded Coder, coder profiles, build settings, data types, fixed‑point).
* Ensure generated C/C\+\+ integrates cleanly with target RTOS/MCU/SoC, HAL/BSP, drivers (SPI, I2C, UART, PWM, ADC, timers), and communication stacks (CAN, Ethernet if applicable).
* Enforce coding standards (e.g., MISRA‑C/C\+\+), static analysis, and defensively designed runtime checks.
* Establish model‑in‑the‑loop (MIL), software‑in‑the‑loop (SIL), processor‑in‑the‑loop (PIL), and hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL) strategies, including plant models for electromechanical dynamics.
* Own model coverage, requirement coverage, and code coverage targets; define acceptance criteria and entry/exit gates.
* Implement CI/CD for models and generated code, including automated builds, checks, and regression tests.
* Ensure compliance with IEC 62304 (software lifecycle), IEC 60601 (applicable electrical safety), ISO 14971 (risk), ISO 13485 (QMS), and FDA design controls.
* Lead and author deliverables: software plans, architectures, risk controls, verification protocols/reports, trace matrices, and problem reports/CAPA inputs.
* Partner with Cybersecurity (FDA guidance, SBOM, vulnerability handling) and Usability Engineering (IEC 62366\) where SW behavior impacts user risk.
* Work with Electrical/Mechanical to co‑simulate and co‑design plant models (motors, gear trains, loads, sensors, thermal, power).
* Support manufacturing test strategies (boundary tests, calibration models, digital twins) and service diagnostics.
* Guide suppliers/CMs on MBD integration and compliance expectations; review artifacts from external modeling partners.
* Mentor systems, software, and test engineers in MBD, control theory, and verification strategies.
* Drive continuous improvement—templates, scripts, libraries, checkers, and dashboards; conduct design and model reviews.
* Serve as the technical authority for trade‑offs (performance vs. safety vs. cost vs. schedule).

 **Qualifications \& Experience**

**Education**

* Master’s in Electronics and communication, Electrical and Electronics, Automation or Computers engineering or a similar field.

 **Experience \& Expertise**

* 15 years of relevant industrial experience in model based development.
* Exposure to coding standards and SW development life cycle
* Expertise in design control documentation, including Design History Files.
* Proven experience in technical risk assessment, mitigation, and execution.
* Strong analytical skills, and trouble shooting experience in electro\-mechanical devices.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence technical and business decisions at all organizational levels.

title: System Development Engineer II, TFS-Onboarding
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about solving complex financial automation challenges at scale? Amazon's Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is seeking a System Development Engineer II to help revolutionize how we manage financial operations across our global transportation network. In this role, you'll build critical automation solutions that streamline migrations, generate actionable metrics, and enable seamless financial book closures for one of the world's most sophisticated logistics operations.  

  

You'll work at the intersection of software development and financial systems, creating tools and mechanisms that address real customer challenges. Your solutions will empower teams across transportation finance to work more efficiently, make data\-driven decisions faster, and adopt new features with confidence. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact on systems that process financial data at Amazon's scale while growing your technical expertise in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Design and implement automation solutions for device migrations and financial system transitions, ensuring reliability and minimizing manual intervention  

Build and maintain reporting infrastructure that enables accurate and timely financial book closures, collaborating with finance teams to understand requirements  

Develop features and enhancements that improve customer adoption and ease of use, focusing on intuitive interfaces and streamlined workflows  

Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues by analyzing system logs and customer feedback, implementing sustainable solutions that prevent recurrence  

Write clean, maintainable code using optimal data structures and algorithms, participating in code reviews and contributing to team technical standards  

  

A day in the life  

Your day begins by addressing critical tickets from finance teams, investigating root causes and implementing fixes. You'll spend time enabling new reporting capabilities for upcoming book closures, collaborating with stakeholders to ensure accuracy. You will automate migration steps that previously required manual effort, writing scripts and testing thoroughly. In the afternoon, you could be enhancing features based on customer feedback, making iterative improvements that simplify adoption. Throughout the day, you'll participate in code reviews, share knowledge with teammates, and contribute to the team's operational excellence.  

  

About the team  

The Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team plays a crucial role in Amazon's logistics ecosystem, building and maintaining the financial systems that power our global transportation network. We're a collaborative team of engineers and analysts who value creative problem\-solving and continuous learning. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable financial tools that help transportation teams operate efficiently and make informed decisions.  

  

We foster an environment where curiosity thrives and knowledge\-sharing is part of our daily routine. Whether you're automating complex workflows, generating insights from financial data, or building customer\-facing features, you'll have opportunities to grow your skills and make meaningful contributions. Join us in shaping the future of transportation finance at Amazon.

------------------------

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust
* Experience with Linux/Unix
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with distributed systems at scale

description:

* To lead a configuration\-first data platform, using reusable frameworks, metadata\-driven pipelines and low\-code/no\-code engineering principles

title: Lead Fabric Data engineer
description:
**Job Summary**  

  



We are looking for an experienced Lead Fabric Data Engineer to design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric for our Industrial Gas project.


The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory, Data Warehouse, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and Power BI. You will be responsible for building robust data pipelines, implementing Medallion Architecture, optimizing data processing workloads, and ensuring high\-quality, secure, and reliable data solutions.


You will work closely with architects, business stakeholders, data engineers, and analytics teams to deliver enterprise\-grade data platforms and analytics solutions.


**Roles \& Responsibilities**


* Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Build and maintain end\-to\-end data pipelines using Fabric Data Factory, Pipelines, and Dataflows Gen2\.
* Develop data ingestion and transformation processes across structured and semi\-structured data sources.
* Implement Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold) using Fabric Lakehouse.
* Develop and optimize PySpark/Spark notebooks for large\-scale data processing and transformation.
* Design and implement data models and curated datasets for analytics and reporting.
* Develop solutions using Fabric Data Warehouse and T\-SQL for analytical workloads.
* Work with Delta Lake and optimize storage, partitioning, and data processing strategies.
* Implement incremental data loads, slowly changing dimensions, data quality checks, and error\-handling frameworks.
* Integrate data from multiple sources including Azure, SQL Server, APIs, files, and legacy data platforms.
* Optimize pipeline performance, Spark workloads, SQL queries, and Fabric capacity utilization.
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, Git integration, and deployment processes for Fabric artifacts.
* Work with Azure DevOps/GitHub to manage source code, releases, and development workflows.
* Implement appropriate data security, access controls, and workspace\-level governance.
* Collaborate with Power BI developers and analytics teams to provide optimized datasets and Semantic Models.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and ensure timely resolution.
* Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, technical design sessions, and solution walkthroughs.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level data engineers and promote data engineering best practices.
* Ensure solutions meet performance, scalability, reliability, security, and data quality standards.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**


* 6–8 years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Development, or related data technology roles.
* 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric or strong experience in Azure data platforms with practical Fabric implementation experience.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Microsoft Fabric and OneLake.
* Expertise in Fabric Data Factory, Data Pipelines, Dataflows Gen2, Lakehouse, and Data Warehouse.
* Strong experience with PySpark/Spark and Python for large\-scale data processing.
* Strong proficiency in SQL/T\-SQL and experience developing complex queries and transformations.
* Good understanding of Delta Lake and Medallion Architecture.
* Experience implementing Bronze, Silver, and Gold data layers.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT development and data integration patterns.
* Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data sources.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory and/or Azure Synapse Analytics is preferred.
* Experience with Power BI and Semantic Models is an added advantage.
* Knowledge of Direct Lake and Fabric performance optimization is preferred.
* Experience with Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, and Fabric deployment pipelines.
* Good understanding of data security, access controls, data governance, and workspace management.
* Experience with data quality, monitoring, logging, and production support.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* Ability to work independently as well as lead and mentor technical team members.

What You Will Do


As a Lead Fabric Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building and modernizing enterprise data platforms using Microsoft Fabric. You will work on challenging data engineering problems, develop scalable cloud data solutions, and contribute to the successful delivery of modern analytics capabilities for our clients.

description:

* Experience with metadata/catalog systems including Nessie, Glue, or Hive Metastore.

* Strong understanding of Parquet, ORC, and Avro data formats.
* Experience with object storage systems like S3, ADLS, GCS, or Nutanix Object Storage.
* Strong programming skills in Python / PySpark / Scala.
* Experience with Airflow, Kestra, or similar orchestration tools.
* Hands\-on exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP cloud platforms.

* Impactful Work: Build large\-scale data platforms and analytics systems that power real\-time communication products used by millions globally.
* Tremendous Growth Opportunities: Accelerate your career by solving complex engineering challenges in a fast\-growing CPaaS and product\-driven environment.

title: Development Manager
description:
About Kanerika
 




**Who we are:**




 Kanerika Inc. is a premier global software products and services firm specializing in providing innovative solutions and services for data\-driven enterprises. We help businesses achieve digital transformation and maximize impact through data and AI, leveraging advanced technologies in analytics, governance, AI/ML, and GenAI/LLM to optimize operations, enhance customer experience, and drive growth.
 



  






 Awards and Recognitions:
 




 Kanerika has won several awards over the years, including:
 


1. Best Place to Work 2023 by Great Place to Work®
2. Top10 Most Recommended RPA Start\-Ups in 2022 by RPA Today
3. CMMI Level 3 Appraised in 2024
4. Frost \& Sullivan India 2021 Technology Innovation Award for its Kompass composable solution architecture
5. Kanerika has also been recognized for its commitment to customer privacy and data security, having achieved ISO 27701, ISO 9001, SOC2, and GDPR compliances.



  





**Locations:**




 We are located in Austin (USA), Singapore, Hyderabad, Indore and Ahmedabad (India).
 



**Job Location:
 
 Hyderabad, Indore and Ahmedabad.** 




**Department:
 
 Product Development** 




**Employment Type:
 
 Full\-Time** 




**Experience Required:
 
 6 – 8 Years** 




**Reporting To:
 
 Product Leader** 




  





**Role
 
 :** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on and technically sharp Development Manager to lead the engineering of FLIP's BI Migration Plugins within the Product Development team. You will be joining a team of highly competent, high\-energy engineers who take strong ownership of what they build — we are looking for someone who matches that drive and raises the bar further.
 



 This role sits at the intersection of product engineering and delivery— you will own the end\-to\-end development lifecycle of BI migration plugins, working closely with the Product Leader to drive the roadmap from conception to production. You will both build new migration capabilities from scratch on the FLIP platform and enhance the existing suite of plugins that power migrations from tools like Cognos, SSRS, Crystal Reports, and Tableau to Power BI.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:**




  





**Plugin Development \& Engineering** 



* Architect, design, and build new BI migration plugins on the FLIP platform from the ground up, covering source analysis, metadata extraction, logic conversion, and target generation.
* Enhance and extend existing FLIP plugins for migrations including Cognos → Power BI, SSRS → Power BI, Crystal Reports → Power BI, Tableau → Power BI, and other BI migration paths.
* Own end\-to\-end development: from requirement analysis and design through coding, testing, deployment, and post\-release maintenance.
* Ensure plugins handle complex scenarios such as VB.NET/DAX expression conversion, visual mapping, parameterized reports, paginated report generation, and data model transformation.



  





**Technical Leadership** 



* Work alongside a team of highly competent, high\-energy engineers on FLIP plugin modules — conduct code reviews, set engineering standards, and contribute to a culture of technical excellence.
* Collaborate closely with the Product Leader to translate product roadmap requirements into detailed technical specifications and delivery plans.
* Drive architectural decisions around plugin framework design, scalability, extensibility, and quality.
* Define and enforce engineering best practices, coding standards, and automated testing strategies for the plugin development lifecycle.



  





**Delivery \& Collaboration** 



* Manage sprint planning, task estimation, and delivery milestones for plugin development cycles.
* Working close coordination with migration consultants and QA engineers to ensure plugin output achieves functional equivalence and data integrity between source and target platforms.
* Proactively identify and resolve technical blockers, bottlenecks, and risks across the development pipeline.
* Contribute to documentation of plugin architecture, migration logic, and technical runbooks.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Analyze client migration feedback and production issues to drive iterative improvement of existing plugins.
* Evaluate emerging BI tools and platform APIs to identify new migration accelerator opportunities.
* Contribute ideas and POCs to expand FLIP's migration coverage and automation depth.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**




**Experience** 



* 6–8 years of total experience in software/product development, with at least 2 years in a technical lead or engineering management role.
* Proven experience in building or working on BI/data migration tools, platforms, or accelerators.
* Hands\-on experience with one or more source BI platforms: IBM Cognos, SSRS, Crystal Reports, Tableau, MicroStrategy, or similar.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI — familiarity with Power BI data models, DAX, Power BI Service, paginated reports, and Power BI Report Builder is an advantage.



  





**Technical Skills** 



* Strong proficiency in Python and/or Java for backend plugin development; good working knowledge of the Spring Boot framework and Angular is required.
* Experience with XML/JSON parsing, metadata extraction, AST processing, or code\-to\-code transformation techniques.
* Familiarity with low\-code/no\-code platform development or plugin/extension framework design.
* Exposure to REST API integration and cloud platforms (Azure preferred); good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps best practices including version control, automated testing, containerisation, and release management.
* Comfortable working with SQL, data modeling concepts, and schema conversion techniques.



  





**Leadership \& Interpersonal Skills** 



* Ability to coordinate and work effectively with a team of engineers — comfortable guiding peers and facilitating technical discussions.
* Excellent communication skills — able to interface clearly with the Product Leader and cross\-functional teams.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to break down complex technical challenges into actionable development tasks.
* Detail\-oriented and quality\-driven, with a strong sense of ownership over product outcomes.



  





**Good to Have:**



* Prior experience building SaaS products or platform plugins in a product company.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Fabric — including Fabric workloads, pipelines, and data platform capabilities — is a plus.
* Knowledge of RPA platforms such as UiPath or Microsoft Power Automate.
* Experience with Informatica, Alteryx, SSIS, or other ETL tools.
* Exposure to LLM/AI\-assisted code conversion or metadata intelligence use cases.



  





**What You Will Work On at Kanerika:**




 Your core focus will be building and improving FLIP's BI Migration Plugin suite. You will work across multiple migration paths — such as Cognos, SSRS, Crystal Reports, and Tableau to Power BI — developing the plugin logic that handles metadata extraction, expression conversion, visual mapping, and report generation. You will also take on new migration paths as the product roadmap evolves, contributing directly to the platform's growing coverage and automation depth.
 



  





**Why Join Kanerika:**



* Work on a high\-impact, proprietary product platform (FLIP) that is transforming enterprise data modernization.
* Be part of a fast\-growing, Microsoft Solutions Partner firm with a strong focus on innovation and delivery excellence.
* Opportunity to build and lead an engineering team in a domain\-critical vertical — BI migration is at the heart of Kanerika's growth trajectory.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge AI, automation, and cloud\-native data platform technologies.



  





**Employee Benefits:**

title: Storefront and eCommerce
description:
* About the role  

  

As our Storefront and CRO Manager, you will be the centre of expertise for everything that happens on our storefronts. You will own and drive the storefront experience for Crazy Domains, Vodien and BigRock, and support the wider Digipac group of brands.  

  

Our brands sit across a mix of platforms including WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager and our own in\-house stack, with control panels managed separately. A significant part of this role is bringing a coherent roadmap, one standard of experience and one testing discipline across all of them, while respecting where each brand needs to be different.  

  

You will be accountable for the storefront roadmap and for the commercial outcomes that come with it, with a focus on conversion rate, cross sell, and the overall quality of the customer experience. You will work with marketing, design, engineering, analytics and brand teams to make sure everything that ships is consistent with our wider eCommerce and marketing strategy.  

  

This role offers a largely remote working experience with flexible working hours and the opportunity to work with teams across the globe.
* Job Description**What you will own**


Targets are agreed by brand at the start of each financial year with the eCommerce and brand leads. Baselines are set in your first quarter.

**Revenue and conversion**


	+ **Storefront conversion rate.** Improve visit to cart and cart to purchase across priority funnels for each brand.
	+ **Cross sell and attach rate.** Grow attach of adjacent products at cart, checkout and in the control panel, measured by attach rate and revenue per visit.
	+ **Average order value and revenue per session.** Own the onsite levers that move both, including merchandising, pricing presentation, bundling and upgrade paths.**Experience and performance**


	+ **Site performance.** Page load and Core Web Vitals on key templates, with particular attention to mobile.
	+ **Experience quality.** Reduction in onsite defects reaching production, faster time to resolution on storefront bugs, improved task success and friction scores from behavioral and qualitative research.
	+ **Consistency across brands.** A shared component and experience standard applied across the portfolio, so that a fix or a win on one brand can be reused rather than rebuilt.**Delivery and process**


	+ **Experimentation velocity.** An agreed number of tests live per quarter, each with a documented hypothesis, a clean readout and a decision logged, whether the test wins or loses.
	+ **Roadmap delivery.** Percentage of committed roadmap delivered in the quarter, and cycle time from PRD to live.
	+ **Delivery against Strategi Project.** Own and deliver platform support where applicable for strategic global projects such as brand migrations and consolidations **A day in the life of our Storefront and Conversion Manager**

**Core deliverables**


	+ Build, maintain and track the storefront and control panel roadmap across Crazy Domains, Vodien, BigRock and the Digipac brands, keeping it continuously aligned with business strategy and with the commercial priorities of each brand.
	+ Manage the execution of storefront and customer panel driven marketing, UX and product initiatives from idea through to live.
	+ Run a continuous onsite testing program, using tools like Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and other forms of customer insight, and turn what you learn into a prioritized backlog rather than a folder of results.
	+ Create PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and build wireframes and high level mockups in Figma alongside our Design team to define desired outcomes.
	+ Make and manage day to day content, layout and campaign updates on our WordPress properties, and scope and brief larger changes to engineering for our AEM and in\-house stacks.
	+ Lead storefront redesign and rebranding work as it comes up, covering page templates, navigation, product and pricing pages, cart and checkout.
	+ Worl closely with storefront QA and pre release teams, so that what goes live matches what was specified and does not quietly break something else.
	+ Actively participate in and represent marketing in weekly project grooming, sprint planning and release readiness in Jira.
	+ Continuously measure and report key storefront metrics including conversion rate, click and engagement metrics, funnel drop off and load time.**Stakeholder management**


	+ Proactively manage all relevant stakeholders including senior management, building consensus and commitment to project outcomes.
	+ Work with brand and marketing leads across the portfolio to sequence competing requests into a single roadmap, and be comfortable explaining why something is not being built this quarter.
	+ Work collaboratively with cross functional stakeholders and in close conjunction with design and engineering teams to align on roadmaps and deliverables across all three stacks.
	+ Engage and cultivate relationships with partners across the business, gain insight and adopt best practices.
	+ Partner closely with Analytics and BI teams to evolve our understanding of performance across eCommerce.
	+ Collaborate with marketing, sales and support teams on go to market planning for products and campaigns.
	+ Close the loop with customer support and care teams, using what they hear every day as a source of onsite improvements.**Data and analysis**


	+ Monitor, report and find ways to improve platform performance across brands and funnel steps.
	+ Work with the BI team to build visibility for key platform metrics, including dashboards that let brand teams self serve.
	+ Investigate anomalies and conversion drops quickly, and separate a tracking problem from a real experience problem.
	+ Analyze data from internal and external sources to develop strategies and define platform objectives.
	+ Leverage data and insight to continually optimize and maximize the value of our platform and processes.
	+ Benchmark our storefronts against competitors and against good practice outside our category.
* Additional Job Description**What you will need to succeed**


	+ Five or more years in eCommerce, conversion rate optimization, digital product or web experience roles, ideally across multiple brands or markets.
	+ A demonstrable track record of moving conversion rate, attach rate or average order value, with the ability to talk through how you did it and what you learned when it did not work.
	+ A keen eye for good design and a strong understanding of user experience.
	+ A customer first mindset and the ability to apply design thinking principles.
	+ Data driven, but able to make a judgement call when the data is thin or the sample is small.
	+ Strong working knowledge of tracking customer journeys, event and tag setup, and the ability to analyze and act on what you see.
	+ Hands on experience with Figma and Jira. Both are everyday tools in this role, not occasional ones.
	+ Comfortable working directly in AEM/WordPress (or have the willingness to learn this). You should be able to make and QA basic content, layout and template updates yourself without waiting in a development queue. Experience with Adobe Experience Manager or a similar enterprise CMS is a strong advantage.
	+ A working understanding of HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Enough to read a page, spot what is wrong, estimate effort and hold a credible conversation with engineers. You will not be asked to ship production code.
	+ Experience with analytics and experimentation tooling such as Google Analytics, Hotjar, Optimizely and similar.
	+ Strong communication, organizational and analytical skills.
	+ Attention to detail, comfort with multitasking, and a customer service focus.
	+ Independent thinking, and not being afraid to suggest new ideas.
	+ Experience working in an agile organization or with cross functional teams.
	+ Ability to build collaborative relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.

title: Associate, Workflow Modelling and Orchestration - Parametric
description:
ABOUT MORGAN STANLEY
  

Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, wealth management and investment management services. With offices in more than 41 countries, the Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, institutions and individuals. For further information about Morgan Stanley, please visit www.morganstanley.com.
  

  

ABOUT PARAMETRIC
  

Parametric is part of Morgan Stanley Investment Management, the asset management division of Morgan Stanley. We partner with advisors, institutions, and consultants to build portfolios focused on what is important to them and their clients. A leader in custom solutions for more than 30 years, we help investors access efficient market exposures, solve implementation challenges, and design multi\-asset portfolios that respond to their evolving needs. We also offer systematic alpha and alternative strategies to complement clients' core holdings.
  

  

This role is part of Parametric's hybrid working model, which includes working in the office 3 days a week and choosing to work remotely or in the office the remaining days of the week.
  

  

ABOUT THE TEAM
  

The Automation, Reinvention and Collaboration (ARC) team is part of Parametric Operations. The Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team designs, builds, tests, and delivers enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda\-based workflow platform.
  

  

ABOUT THE ROLE
  

Parametric is seeking an Associate to join the Workflow Modelling and Orchestration team to support the design, build, testing, and delivery of enterprise operational workflows through Workflow Center, Parametric's Camunda\-based workflow platform.
  

  

The role is a hands\-on workflow practitioner who translates complex operational processes into clear requirements and executable workflows. Working with Operations, Product, Technology, Risk and platform teams, the role supports the full workflow lifecycle from discovery and BPMN/DMN modelling through testing, deployment readiness and production support. The role requires practical process analysis, attention to controls and exceptions, and a willingness to develop deeper Camunda expertise.
  

  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES


* Discover and define workflows: Lead or support discovery sessions; document business objectives, triggers, actors, systems, data, controls, handoffs, SLAs, decisions and exception scenarios; translate incomplete processes into structured, testable requirements.
* Model executable processes: Design end\-to\-end BPMN 2\.0 workflows and DMN decision logic, including user and service tasks, events, gateways, subprocesses, approvals, escalations, retries, rework and manual\-intervention paths.
* Configure Workflow Center solutions: Configure models, forms, variables, business rules, task assignments and approved platform components; partner with engineers to define service interactions, APIs, data mappings and integration dependencies.
* Support end\-to\-end delivery: Contribute from intake and design through functional testing, UAT, deployment readiness, hypercare and production analysis; prepare test scenarios, investigate defects and maintain delivery and operating documentation.
* Embed controls and operational resilience: Model maker\-checker controls, evidence requirements, rejection and resubmission, attestations, auditability and exception handling; escalate unclear requirements, conflicting rules and unresolved risks.
* Collaborate and communicate: Facilitate workshops and model walkthroughs; explain workflow behaviour in business language; provide concise updates on progress, decisions, dependencies, risks and defects.
* Apply standards and promote reuse: Follow BPMN, DMN, documentation, testing, naming and review standards; use and improve reusable patterns, templates, checklists and playbooks.

JOB QUALIFICATIONS


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related area of study.
* 4\+ years of professional experience in workflow modelling, business process management, process automation, business analysis, operations transformation or a related discipline.
* Hands\-on experience creating executable BPMN 2\.0 models, with a sound understanding of events, tasks, gateways, subprocesses, messages, timers, boundary events and exception paths.
* Ability to gather requirements and translate complex or incomplete operational processes into structured models, decision logic and clear documentation.
* Understanding operational controls, approvals, handoffs, task assignment, SLAs, auditability and exception management.
* Experience preparing test scenarios, documenting defects and supporting functional testing or UAT.
* Strong analytical, written and verbal communication skills; ability to manage assigned work, raise risks early and collaborate with business and technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications


* Hands\-on experience with Camunda 8, Camunda Modeler or another executable workflow platform, including BPMN, DMN, forms, variables or connectors.
* Familiarity with FEEL, REST APIs, JSON, events, messaging, SQL or enterprise\-system integrations.
* Experience with Jira and Confluence and with reviewing workflow instances, variables, incidents, logs or execution paths.
* Financial\-services or other regulated\-industry experience; exposure to onboarding, oversight, reconciliation, approvals, investment operations or exception management.
* BPMN, Camunda, business analysis or process\-management training or certification

Parametric believes each member of our organization makes a significant contribution to our success. That contribution should not be limited by the assigned responsibilities. Therefore, this job description is designed to outline primary duties and qualifications. It is our expectation that every member of our team will offer his/her/their services wherever and whenever necessary to ensure the success of our business.


**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM MORGAN STANLEY:**

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work\-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.


To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about\-us/global\-offices into your browser.


Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.


Our workforce reflects a broad cross\-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.


For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people\-opportunities/eeo .

**About HG** 




 HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points.
 



 Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation.
 



**About the Role** 




 This is a senior individual contributor role on the team that builds and runs HG's data platform: everything between a raw vendor file landing in our lake and a finished dataset arriving in a customer's hands. It includes the transformation stack that turns messy external signals into product\-grade company attributes, the matching systems that decide which company a piece of evidence belongs to and the internal applications our analysts use to curate and correct the result.
 



 You will be based in Pune, working with engineers at our Pune, US \& Brazil locations.
 



**What you’ll do** 



* Own the architecture of the data platform end to end, and make the calls on build vs. buy, batch vs. incremental, and where each workload belongs.
* Build the quality layer that catches silent failure: contracts at every handoff, freshness and completeness monitoring, and pipelines that quarantine bad data rather than publish it.
* Improve entity matching and attribution — and make match decisions explainable to the customers who depend on them.
* Make our release cycle boring. Recurring deliveries should not depend on people watching them.
* Treat compute cost as a first\-class engineering metric across Spark, orchestration, and the serving tier.

 As a key member of the Digital Platform team, this role will enable product, analytics, and AI teams to deliver value faster by providing standardized data models, reusable pipelines, and self\-service access to trusted data. The role ensures the platform is scalable, secure, and cost\-effective, while supporting critical capabilities such as asset and telemetry processing, data quality, lineage, and integration with machine learning services.
   

  

 This position is accountable for improving platform reliability, performance and transparency through strong engineering practices, automation, and observability, and for enforcing governance through clear data standards, access controls, and lifecycle management. This role will drive strategic investments in shared data capabilities, prioritize platform enhancements that unlock business value, and ensure the platform evolves in alignment with enterprise architecture and long\-term cloud strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Platform Architecture \& Roadmap


 Own the technical vision and evolution of the enterprise data platform aligned to business and digital strategy.
   

  

 Define the target architecture for real\-time and batch data processing, including Medallion architecture patterns and event\-driven pipelines.
   

  

 Translate platform strategy into quarterly technical objectives, capacity plans, and measurable engineering outcomes.
   

  

* Core Data Platform Capabilities


 Design and operate the enterprise data storage using Amazon S3 and Apache Iceberg.
   

  

 Implement and mature Bronze–Silver–Gold (Medallion) architecture for structured, governed data processing.
   

  

 Define and maintain reusable building blocks for ingestion, transformation, storage, and serving.
   

  

 Establish reference implementations for streaming (Lambda/Flink) and batch ETL (Spark/Flink).

 Provide standardized pipelines, templates, and patterns to enable analytics, applications, and ML teams to consume data efficiently.
   

  

 Enable self\-service access to trusted datasets through Athena/Trino, APIs, and ML pipelines.
   

  

 Partner with application, edge, and ML teams to ensure seamless integration from telemetry to business\-ready data.
   

  

* Reliability, Security \& Compliance


 Enforce enterprise\-grade security and governance using Lake Formation, IAM, and KMS.
   

  

 Implement data quality, validation, lineage, and observability controls across pipelines.
   

  

 Design for resilience through robust error handling, reprocessing, and backfill mechanisms.
   

  

 Establish and maintain automated unit testing for data transformations, schemas, and business logic.
   

  

 Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
   

  

* Performance, Cost \& Scalability


 Design and Optimize storage, compute, and query performance for cost efficiency and predictable scaling.
   

  

 Monitor and continuously improve platform throughput, latency, and unit economics (e.g., cost per GB, cost per pipeline).
   

  

* Cross\-Functional Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement


 Work closely with edge, application, analytics, and AI teams to translate raw telemetry into trusted business insights.
   

  

 Partner with architecture, security, and cloud teams to align platform implementation with enterprise standards.
   

  

 Act as a technical advisor to product and business stakeholders on data platform capabilities and constraints.

 Individual Contributor

 We are looking for an experienced Lead Fabric Data Engineer to design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions using Microsoft Fabric for our Industrial Gas project. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on expertise in Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, Lakehouse, Data Factory, Data Warehouse, Spark/PySpark, SQL, and Power BI. You will work on challenging data engineering problems, develop scalable cloud data solutions, and contribute to the successful delivery of modern analytics capabilities for our clients.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Summary NCS Pte Ltd is seeking a Senior Data Engineer with strong hands-on technical depth and independent problem-solving ability to support a large-scale data platform migration engagement with Singtel. The role involves reviewing vendor-produced source-to-target mappings, validating data schema designs, and building robust ETL pipelines and data mart layers on Databricks (Azure) to power downstream Power BI dashboards and scheduled reporting. The successful candidate will work directly within the NCS delivery team alongside Singtel stakeholders and the incumbent vendor, taking full ownership of the data engineering workstream - from schema validation through pipeline development, data quality assurance, and go-live support. Key Responsibilities Schema Review & Data Validation Review and validate design spec for data marts to be developed in Databricks. Assess the optimized data schema proposed by the vendor to confirm completeness, correctness of data types, and alignment with business requirements. Cross-reference the backend queries of Cognos reports against the proposed schema to ensure all required tables and fields are included. Identify gaps, redundancies, and inconsistencies; document findings and work collaboratively with the vendor and Singtel teams to resolve them. ETL Pipeline Development Design and build scalable, optimized ETL pipelines in Databricks using PySpark and SQL to ingest, transform, and load data. Develop aggregated views and data mart layers to serve as the analytical foundation for Power BI dashboards and Databricks scheduled reports. Implement robust error handling, logging, data validation checks, and reconciliation frameworks across all pipeline stages. Data Architecture & Goverce Apply medallion architecture (Bronze / Silver / Gold) principles to organize data layers within Databricks Unity Catalog. Maintain and contribute to the data catalogue, data dictionary, business glossary, and technical data lineage documentation. Ensure data modelling standards, naming conventions, and data type conversion guidelines are adhered to across all deliverables. AI-Accelerated Delivery Leverage AI-powered developer tools/features (e.g., Databricks Assistant, Genie, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate ETL code generation, schema analysis, and validation tasks. Champion automation-first practices within the team; identify repetitive tasks suitable for AI augmentation and implement accordingly. Stakeholder & Vendor Engagement Actively participate in client workshops, technical reviews, and sprint ceremonies with Singtel stakeholders and the platform vendor. Proactively communicate risks, propose mitigations, and escalate blockers with a solutions-focused mindset. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, status reports, and delivery artifacts to the standard expected in a large enterprise engagement. Mandatory Skills & Experience Core Technical Proficiency Strong hands-on experience with SQL, Python, and PySpark for data transformation and pipeline development. Hands-on production experience with Databricks: ETL pipeline build, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Databricks Workflows, and Databricks SQL. Hands-on experience with Oracle (on-premises) - including reading Oracle schemas, understanding execution plans, and migrating Oracle SQL to Spark SQL. Data Engineering Fundamentals Strong knowledge of ETL/ELT development patterns, incremental loading, SCD handling, and change data capture. Experience with data validation frameworks, reconciliation strategies, and exception/error handling at scale. Solid understanding of data modelling (relational, dimensional, and flat/wide schemas) and data architecture patterns (medallion, star schema, data vault). Practical experience creating and maintaining source-to-target mapping documents, data dictionaries, and business glossaries. Knowledge of data type conversion challenges between Oracle and Spark/Databricks environments. AI & Automation Tools Ability to critically evaluate and refine AI-generated code for production-quality data pipelines. Experience Level Minimum 5 years of relevant working experience in data engineering roles. Prior experience in a data platform migration engagement (on-premises to cloud) is strongly preferred. Professional & Technical Certifications Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate or Professional (preferred) Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203) (preferred) Microsoft Certified: Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900) (advantageous) Oracle Database SQL Certified Associate (advantageous) Any recognized AI/ML certification (e.g., AWS Certified Machine Learning, Google Professional Data Engineer) (advantageous) Good to Have Skills Familiarity with Cognos report structures and backend SQL, enabling effective analysis of report dependencies. Experience with Power BI data models (DirectQuery, import, composite) to support collaboration with the BI team. Knowledge of Apache Spark performance tuning, query optimization, and cluster configuration on Databricks. Exposure to data quality frameworks (e.g., Great Expectations, Databricks Delta Live Tables constraints). Understanding of DevOps/DataOps practices: Git branching, CI/CD pipelines for data, and automated testing of data pipelines. Experience working in Agile / Scrum delivery teams in a client-facing consulting environment. Familiarity with Singtels data ecosystem or telco industry data models is an advantage. Soft & Interpersonal Skills Strong technical and logical reasoning skills - ability to independently understand complex work scopes, identify the right approach, and articulate trade-offs clearly. Ownership and accountability mindset - takes responsibility for deliverable quality and timelines without requiring close supervision. Proactive risk identification - surfaces risks early, proposes practical mitigations, and drives resolution. Positive, can-do attitude - maintains constructive energy under pressure and in ambiguous situations. Client stakeholder management - communicates professionally with Singtel business and technical stakeholders at various levels. Vendor collaboration - works constructively with the incumbent platform vendor, balancing assertiveness with diplomacy. Strong team player - contributes to team knowledge sharing, pair reviews, and collective problem-solving. Clear written and verbal communication - able to produce high-quality technical documentation and present findings concisely.

title: Data Engineer III - Data Platform
description:
**Who We Are**
 Zinnia is the leading technology platform for accelerating life and annuities growth. With innovative enterprise solutions and data insights, Zinnia simplifies the experience of buying, selling, and administering insurance products. All of which enables more people to protect their financial futures. Our success is driven by a commitment to three core values: be bold, team up, deliver value – and that we do. Zinnia has over $180 billion in assets under administration, serves 100\+ carrier clients, 2500 distributors and partners, and over 2 million policyholders.
   

  

**Who You Are**
 You are a Data Engineer who wants to go deep on platform and infrastructure work — building the pipelines, storage, and platform foundations that the rest of the business builds on. You think in terms of well\-modeled data, reliable orchestration, and infrastructure that holds up under real production load.
   

  

 You are comfortable with SQL and Python, know your way around AWS core services, and can take a clear set of requirements and turn them into solid, well\-tested outcomes. You are curious about how data platforms can be setup, scaled, integrated in the wider application ecosystem and resulting data feeds downstream analytics and machine learning use cases.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build and maintain scalable, reliable data platforms and pipelines that power analytics and data\-driven products across Zinnia.
* Work within the data platform's AWS infrastructure — storage, IAM, compute and orchestration services — implementing and tuning components under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Implement and integrate with telemetry and observability solutions for Infrastructure and Platform reliability.
* Provision and modify data infrastructure components (S3 buckets, IAM roles, Lambda, RDS/Aurora, compute resources) using Terraform, including Snowflake infrastructure\-as\-code (warehouses, roles, databases), working from existing modules and patterns.
* Familiarity with streaming or event\-driven data (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar)
* Package, deploy, and manage pipeline components as containerized services (ex: Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, ECS), including EKS cluster upgrades and configuration changes
* Implement data quality checks, monitoring, and basic lineage so downstream teams can trust the data they're consuming.
* Contribute to data governance, access control, and cost\-optimization practices within AWS and Snowflake.
* Troubleshoot pipeline and infrastructure issues, escalating and collaborating with senior engineers on complex or systemic problems.
* Write clear documentation and follow established technical standards for the data platform.
* Develop and maintain ELT/ETL workflows using Airflow, dbt, and Airbyte (or similar ingestion tools) for self\-serve data access
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted engineering tools and platforms (e.g., Claude, Cortex Code), LLM\-based workflows, and agentic automation to support infrastructure and platform changes


**What You’ll Need**
* 4\+ years of experience in Data Engineering, with a focus on Data
* Hands\-on experience with AWS core services (e.g., S3, IAM, compute services)
* Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data transformation and pipeline development.
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or similar.
* Working knowledge of Airflow for orchestration and scheduling, including managed Airflow (MWAA) or similar hosted\-Airflow configuration and environment management.
* Experience/awareness with dbt, including dbt Cloud, for transformations, testing, documentation, and job/environment configuration.
* Solid understanding of data modeling fundamentals (dimensional and fact\-based designs).
* Comfort working in agile, cross\-functional teams alongside more senior engineers, analysts, and data scientists.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills.


**Nice to have:**
* Exposure to MLOps concepts — training data pipelines, feature generation, or model monitoring data.
* Experience with Airbyte or similar ELT ingestion tools.
* Familiarity with CI/CD practices for data pipelines, including building and maintaining GitHub repositories and GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Experience in a regulated industry such as insurance or financial services.

 Costco Wholesale is a multi\-billion\-dollar global retailer with warehouse club operations in eleven countries.  At Costco Wholesale India, we foster a collaborative space, working to support Costco Wholesale in developing innovative solutions that improve members’ experiences and make employees’ jobs easier.  The Data Engineer is a individual contributor (IC) responsible for designing, building, and evolving the company’s data platform and high\-impact data products so analytics, BI, AI/ML, and operational use cases are reliable, secure, and scalable. This role blends hands\-on engineering with technical leadership: setting patterns and standards, driving cross\-team alignment, and unblocking complex delivery across the data ecosystem.

* Shape and drive enterprise\-wide data architecture strategy: Define and evolve the long\-term technical vision for scalable, resilient data infrastructure across multiple business units and domains.

* Pioneer advanced and forward\-looking solutions: Introduce novel approaches in real\-time processing, hybrid/multi\-cloud, and AI/ML integration to transform how data is processed and leveraged across the enterprise.
* Mentor and develop senior technical leaders: Influence Principal Engineers, Engineering Managers, and other Staff Engineers; create a culture of deep technical excellence and innovation.
* Establish cross\-org technical standards: Define and enforce best practices for data modeling, pipeline architecture, governance, and compliance at scale.
* Solve the most complex, ambiguous challenges: Tackle systemic issues in data scalability, interoperability, and performance that impact multiple teams or the enterprise as a whole.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership: Provide technical insights to senior executives on data strategy, emerging technologies, and long\-term investments.
* Represent the organization as a thought leader: Speak at industry events/conferences, publish thought leadership, contribute to open source and standards bodies, and lead partnerships with external research or academic institutions.

* 8 years of experience
* **Mastery of GCP Data Ecosystem** 
 : Deep authority in architecting, designing, and building complex solutions using
 **BigQuery** 
 ,

 , and
 **Pub/Sub**
