We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

**Job Summary**


We are seeking a skilled hands\-on **IT Analyst Technical Infrastructure (ITSM reporting/SLM Metrics)** to join our **ITSM team** – **Caterpillar IT, India GCC.**


The role involves design, develop, deploy and maintain enterprise ITSM data, analytics, reporting, automation and AI capabilities. The role will support ServiceNow reporting and Platform Analytics, Snowflake data structures, Power BI dashboards, Python/SQL\-based automation, service\-level metrics and data governance. The incumbent will partner with ITSM process owners and business stakeholders to provide reliable operational insights, improve reporting efficiency and enable data\-driven decisions across Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Level Management.


The preference for this role is to be based out of Bangalore **– Caterpillar PSN , Whitefield**

**What you will do**

**Job Duties/Responsibilities will include:**

* Design, develop and maintain enterprise ITSM dashboards, reports and analytical solutions using **Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow and Platform Analytics**.
* Develop and maintain **Snowflake tables, views, queries and data models** supporting ITSM reporting, service\-level metrics and operational analysis.
* Use **Python and SQL** to automate data preparation, validation, reconciliation and recurring reporting activities.
* Maintain data quality, reporting accuracy, metric definitions and appropriate governance for ITSM data consumed through ServiceNow, Snowflake, Power BI and approved AI solutions.
* Support the modernization and migration of legacy ITSM reporting and ServiceNow Platform Analytics solutions.
* Analyze Incident, Problem, Change and Release data to identify recurring issues, root\-cause trends, operational risks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop reporting for SLA performance, service\-level trends and business\-facing service reviews.
* Partner with ITSM process owners and stakeholders to translate business and operational requirements into reliable analytical solutions.
* Create clear technical documentation, data definitions, operational procedures and knowledge\-transfer materials.
* Support testing, deployment, monitoring and maintenance of reports, data pipelines and automation solutions.
* Develop or support approved **Microsoft Copilot and agent\-based solutions** for ITSM use cases.
* Participate in ITSM governance activities, including Incident, Problem, Change, CAB/eCAB, Release, Service Level Management and IT controls.
* Provide production support for critical reporting and analytics solutions, including planned off\-hours or weekend support when required.
* Contribute into ITSM responsibilities \-
	+ Incident, Problem, Change, and Release Management processes within ServiceNow
	+ Root cause analysis, trend identification, recurring issue elimination, and service improvement initiatives
	+ Enterprise CAB (Americas, EMEA, APAC), ICW calendar coordination, eCAB facilitation, and moratorium governance
	+ Service level monitoring, SLA reporting, stakeholder alignment, and continual service improvement
	+ ServiceNow release testing, Platform Analytics migration initiatives, and tool governance activities
	+ IT controls, compliance, audit readiness, and process documentation
	+ Development and support of Agentic AI, Microsoft Copilot, Sidekick, and automation solutions that improve ITSM processes, reporting, knowledge management, and operational efficiency

**What you will have**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Five or more years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, data engineering or a related technology area.
* Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft Power BI**, including data modelling, dashboard development and report maintenance.
* Working proficiency in **Python and SQL** for analytics, automation and data processing.
* Experience working with **Snowflake, Data Lake or comparable cloud data platforms**.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data, validate results and communicate actionable insights.
* Strong written and verbal communication, customer\-service, teamwork and stakeholder\-management skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently while working effectively in a global, collaborative environment.

**Preferred**

* Experience with **ServiceNow reporting, Performance Analytics or Platform Analytics**.
* Familiarity with ITSM or ITIL processes, including Incident, Problem, Change, Release and Service Level Management.
* Experience developing solutions using **Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Platform or comparable AI and automation technologies**.
* Experience with data governance, data access controls, metric definitions and reporting\-quality assurance.
* ITIL Foundation, Microsoft Power BI, ServiceNow or Snowflake certification.
* **This position requires candidate to work a 5\-day \-a \-week in the office from 1pm \-10pm IST.**

**Skills desired:**

**Technical Excellence:** Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.  

Level Extensive Experience:  

* Advises others on the assessment and provision of all technical solutions.

title: Support and Operations Associate
description:
**Role Overview**  

Support and Operations Associate is an entry\-to\-early\-career role focused on delivering day\-to\-day customer support and operational execution under the guidance of senior team members. This role is ideal for someone building a foundation in fintech payments support, with clear pathways to grow into a Senior Support Engineer role as troubleshooting skills, ownership, and process knowledge develop.  

  

**Customer Support \& Query Resolution**

  

* Handle day\-to\-day customer support tickets and chats within defined SLAs, escalating complex or high\-impact issues to senior team members.
* Investigate and troubleshoot routine customer queries with guidance, ensuring timely and accurate responses.
* Support merchant onboarding activities by assisting with basic testing, documentation, and coordination tasks.
* Assist customers with product walkthroughs and first\-level operational guidance.


Service Quality \& SLA Adherence

  

* Adhere to defined SLAs, response timelines, and support processes for all assigned tickets.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date ticket records, ensuring proper categorization and documentation.
* Flag recurring or unresolved issues to seniors for review and follow\-up.
* Contribute to improving CSAT by maintaining quality and consistency in customer communication.


Basic Technical Troubleshooting

  

* Perform first\-level investigation of payment, payout, and integration\-related queries, escalating unresolved or complex cases to Senior Support Engineers.
* Coordinate with internal teams (Product, Engineering, Operations) as directed for issue follow\-up.
* Provide timely status updates on assigned tickets to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Assist in maintaining incident logs and basic documentation for ongoing issues.


Knowledge Base \& Process Support

  

* Follow established SOPs and troubleshooting guides for issue handling.
* Flag gaps or outdated information in SOPs and knowledge base articles to seniors.
* Support the team in testing and adopting new tools, dashboards, or process changes.


Learning \& Collaboration

  

* Actively build product, process, and troubleshooting knowledge through training and shadowing senior team members.
* Collaborate with peers to share learnings and support each other on ticket handling.
* Participate in team training sessions and apply feedback to improve performance.


Cross\-Functional Support

  

* Assist in coordinating with Product, Tech, and Operations teams on routine issue follow\-ups as guided by seniors.
* Communicate basic status updates on assigned tasks and tickets to relevant stakeholders.
* Support cross\-functional projects (migrations, process rollouts) with execution\-level tasks as assigned.


Reporting \& Tracking

  

* Maintain personal ticket trackers and update status regularly.
* Support seniors in compiling data for SLA adherence, backlog, and resolution timeline reports.
* Assist in preparing basic status updates for ongoing tickets and projects.


Qualifications \& Experience

* **1–3 years** of experience in customer support, operations, or a related field; fintech/payments exposure is a plus but not required.
* Bachelor's degree in any discipline; preference for candidates comfortable with numbers and process\-driven work.
* Comfortable working with support tools (e.g., Freshdesk) and basic spreadsheet tools (Excel/Google Sheets).


Skills \& Attributes

  

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* High attention to detail and comfort following structured processes and SOPs.
* Willingness to learn technical concepts related to payments, payouts, APIs, and reconciliation.
* Ability to work under time\-bound SLAs and prioritize tasks effectively.
* Team player with a proactive, coachable attitude.

**Our Commitment to Fairness**  

Finmo is an inclusive, people\-first workplace that values merit and performance. We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and to fostering a work environment free from discrimination. We evaluate all candidates on the basis of merit, performance, and role fit without regard to age, race, gender, religion, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic unrelated to job performance. At this time, we are only able to consider candidates who are already authorised to work in Singapore.  

  

We provide a supportive environment where our people can grow, contribute meaningfully, and thrive. All hiring decisions are made in accordance with applicable employment and fair employment laws in the country of hire.  

  

**Note:** Submissions by recruitment agencies will not be accepted. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  

  

Thank you for your interest in pursuing a career with Finmo!

title: Power BI SME
description:
Job Description
  
**Role Summary**

Avanade India’s Data \& AI practice is looking for a Power BI Consultant who can take a reporting requirement from the first conversation with a business user through to a published, refreshing, secured dashboard in production. This is a hands\-on build role with real client exposure — you will gather requirements, design the data model, write the DAX, build the visuals and own the solution through go\-live.


We are looking for someone who thinks about the model before the chart. Strong DAX and a clean star schema are what make a dashboard fast, accurate and maintainable, and this role is weighted towards that discipline as much as towards visual design. Programming exposure — particularly Python for data analysis — is a welcome addition and will be supported and developed in the role, but strong Power BI craft is what matters most.


**Key Responsibilities**

* Gather and clarify reporting requirements with business and IT stakeholders — understand the questions being asked, the decisions they support, the underlying data sources and the definitions behind each metric.
* Translate requirements into a solution design: data model, KPI and measure definitions, report structure, navigation, security model and refresh approach.
* Design and build robust Power BI data models — star schema design, fact and dimension tables, relationships and cardinality, date/calendar tables, hierarchies and role\-playing dimensions.
* Write and optimise DAX — measures, calculated columns and tables, time intelligence, variables, context transition, and performance tuning of slow measures.
* Build and maintain Power Query (M) transformations — source connections, cleansing, shaping, merges and appends, query folding awareness, parameters and incremental refresh setup.
* Develop KPI dashboards and analytical reports that are visually clear and decision\-oriented — appropriate visual selection , consistent formatting, drill\-through, bookmarks, tooltips and accessible design.
* Implement row\-level security — role design, DAX filter expressions, static and dynamic RLS patterns — and validate it thoroughly before release.
* Configure and manage Power BI Service operations: workspaces, apps, dataset publishing, scheduled refresh, on\-premises data gateway configuration, refresh failure troubleshooting and access management.
* Profile, validate and reconcile data against source systems — using SQL, and Python where you have it — to investigate anomalies and support analysis that goes beyond the dashboard.
* Write and tune SQL against source systems and data warehouses to extract, validate and shape data for reporting.
* Test and validate reports — reconciliation against source, measure accuracy checks, performance testing on realistic data volumes, and UAT support with business users.
* Document solutions — data dictionaries, measure definitions, model documentation and handover material — and support end users through training and adoption.
* Follow deployment and governance practice: workspace lifecycle, deployment pipelines, version control, naming standards and dataset certification where applicable.
* Contribute to reusable practice assets — report templates, DAX pattern libraries, theme files and accelerators.

  
Qualification
  
**Required Skills \& Experience**

* 3–6 years of hands\-on experience building and delivering Power BI solutions in a client or enterprise environment.
* Strong DAX skills — measures, time intelligence, filter and row context, CALCULATE patterns, and the ability to debug and optimise existing DAX.
* Strong Power Query / M skills for data transformation, including handling multiple and messy source systems.
* Solid data modelling capability — dimensional modelling, star schema design, relationship and granularity decisions, and understanding of why model design drives report performance.
* Proven experience designing and building KPI dashboards that business users actually use , with attention to layout, clarity and interaction design.
* Hands\-on implementation of row\-level security, including dynamic RLS driven by a user/security table.
* Practical experience with Power BI Service administration: workspaces, apps, scheduled refresh , data gateway setup and refresh troubleshooting.
* Experience across the full delivery cycle — requirement gathering, solution design, build, testing, UAT and go\-live support — not only report building to a handed\-over spec.
* Good SQL — joins, aggregations, window functions and query optimisation basics.
* Ability to engage business stakeholders directly, ask clarifying questions and explain technical constraints in plain language.
* Attention to detail on data accuracy, with the habit of reconciling and validating numbers before they reach a user.
**Preferred / Good to Have**

* Programming exposure and data analysis in Python — pandas and numpy for data manipulation, basic visualisation and readable analysis scripts. Good to have rather than essential; an interest in building this skill is valued.
* Microsoft certification PL\-300 (Power BI Data Analyst) or DP\-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer).
* Exposure to Microsoft Fabric — Lakehouse, Warehouse, Dataflows Gen2, semantic models and Direct Lake.
* Experience with Azure data services — Azure SQL, Synapse, Data Factory or Databricks — feeding Power BI datasets.
* Familiarity with Power BI performance tooling: DAX Studio, Tabular Editor, Performance Analyzer and Best Practice Analyzer.
* Experience with paginated reports (Power BI Report Builder) or Power BI Embedded.
* Exposure to Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) for embedded and write\-back scenarios.
* Awareness of data governance and cataloguing — Microsoft Purview, sensitivity labels and dataset certification.
* Version control and CI/CD experience for Power BI (Git integration, deployment pipelines).
* Domain exposure in one or more of manufacturing, BFSI, consumer goods, energy or healthcare reporting.

title: Data Migration Manager
description:
External Job Ad:
**Data Migration Manager**
==========================

**Amazing Career Moments Happen Here**


Applied Systems, Inc., a worldwide leader in insurance technology, is currently searching for a Data Migration Manager to lead a team within our Data Services organization. This role is responsible for the people leadership, delivery oversight, and client\-facing communication needed to ensure that customer data migrations from competitor and legacy systems into Applied Systems SaaS products are executed seamlessly, on time, and with a high standard of quality and customer satisfaction.

**Job Summary**


As a people leader within Data Services, the Manager owns the team's delivery outcomes end to end — from understanding what each customer expects and why, to translating those expectations into the technical work the team needs to complete, to confirming the outcome meets the customer's requirements. The Manager oversees a team of Data Migration Engineers, coaching and guiding their day\-to\-day work, while personally attending customer meetings during US hours to represent Data Services, answer questions in real time, and build trust with the customer directly.


This role works closely with a US\-based Relationship Manager who coordinates with the India\-based teams across multiple workstreams. The Data Migration Manager partners with this Relationship Manager on project status, customer sentiment, risk escalation, and resourcing, ensuring the two roles present a unified, well\-coordinated front to the customer.


This role operates within a global, Follow the Sun delivery model. To attend customer meetings in US time and to keep migrations moving seamlessly across regions and time zones, this position requires willingness to work a night shift aligned with US business hours.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — with demonstrated ability to build rapport and manage expectations with clients, especially customers based in the United States
* Ability to understand a project end to end — grasping customer requirements and business context well enough to translate them into clear technical and operational direction for the team
* Working knowledge of data migration, ETL, or database concepts (for example, data extraction, transformation, data quality, and SQL fundamentals) sufficient to guide a technical team and speak credibly with customers

* Familiarity with supporting infrastructure components including storage, virtualization, networking, identity services, and cloud platforms.
* Practical DR knowledge covering failover/failback, workload recovery, recovery sequencing, dependency mapping, validation, and improvement planning.
* Cyber recovery understanding covering ransomware impacts, clean recovery, database integrity validation, identity recovery, Zero Trust principles, and trusted restore capabilities.
* Strong consulting, stakeholder management, technical documentation, delivery quality, and leadership communication skills.
* Good understanding of on\-premises, cloud, and hybrid hosting models, data center strategies, and database deployment architectures.


**Good To Have Skills**

* Familiarity with enterprise backup platforms, storage technologies, and infrastructure resilience concepts supporting database recovery.

* Ability to independently lead workstreams, manage senior stakeholders, and mentor delivery teams.
* Comfortable working across database, infrastructure, cloud, cyber security, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
* Outcome\-focused mindset with emphasis on actionable recommendations, recovery assurance, and measurable resilience improvements.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
As Specialist of HPC Cloud Engineering, you will maintain and support HPC solutions in the cloud using IaC, CICD, job schedulers (both cloud and on\-premise), researcher pipelines, and cloud\-native services. Automate low\-value tasks to allow scientists to focus on high\-value work, leveraging elastic cloud resources to accelerate workflows. Optimize HPC resource availability, its performance and cloud costs. Collaborate with senior HPC SMEs, Application Support Engineers, and research stakeholders to reduce cycle times, boost efficiencies, and enhance UX, increasing researcher capacity.
  
Ultimately, you will play a key role in implementing scalable and efficient solutions on AWS to support compute\-intensive applications. We are looking for an individual with passion for HPC and motivated to provide worldclass HPC experience to enable research scientists to use the power of leading\-edge science to save and improve lives around the world.
  
  

What will you do in this role
  
* Deploy, maintain and support high\-performance computing clusters, platforms and AWS managed services.
* Monitor and maintain the performance of HPC cluster resources in both on premises and AWS, ensuring high availability, reliability and user experience.
* Optimize compute and data workflows for performance and cost\-efficiency in cloud\-based HPC environments.

* Work within a matrix organizational structure, reporting to both the functional manager and Hyderabad based Director, as well as collaborating with other teams.
* Participate in project planning, execution, and delivery, ensuring alignment with both functional and project goals.

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or any Technology stream.
* 3\-7 years of experience in HPC infrastructure engineering, working with network principles, and system administration for Linux/Unix servers.


Primary skills (must\-have)
  
* Hands\-on proficiency in Linux operating systems, shell scripting, HPC architecture and job schedulers in a DevOps environment.
* Experience with job schedulers and orchestrators viz. GridEngine, PBS Pro, and Altair NavOps.
* Knowledge of network architectures and high\-speed interconnects.
* Strong analytical skills to assess and interpret complex data.

* Proactive approach to identifying and addressing potential risks.

* Experience with disaster recovery, data backup solutions, and virtualization platforms
* Good problem\-solving skills

Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
* Relevant certifications (ideally AWS)
* Familiarity with networking fundamentals (virtual networks, VPNs, firewalls) and storage technologies

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Not many teams aspire to zero. Welcome to the Worldwide Returns, ReCommerce \& Sustainability team (WWR\&R) at Amazon.com.  

  

WW RR\&S is an agile, innovative organization dedicated to ‘making zero happen’ to benefit our customers, our company, and the environment. The mission of WWR\&R is to eliminate defects that cause returns (Zero defects), deliver Zero cost of returns for Amazon, send Zero product waste to landfill, and deliver on Amazon’s commitment to deliver on the Climate Pledge (Net Zero Carbon) – “the 4 Zeros”. We do this by developing groundbreaking products and driving unparalleled operational excellence to help customers keep what they buy, recover returned and damaged product value, keep thousands of tons of waste from landfills, and create the best customer returns experience in the world. We have an eye to the future – we create long\-term value at Amazon by focusing not just on the bottom line, but on the planet. We are building the most sustainable re\-use channel we can by driving multiple aspects of the Circular Economy for Amazon \- returns and recommerce.  

  

Amazon WW RR\&S is comprised of business, product, operational, program, software engineering and data teams that manage the life of a returned or damaged product from a customer to the warehouse and on to its next best use. Our work is broad and deep: we train machine learning models to automate routing and find signals to optimize re\-use; we invent new channels to give products a second life; we develop world\-class product support to help customers love what they buy; we pilot smarter product evaluations; we work from the customer backward to find ways to make the return experience remarkably delightful and easy; and we do it all while scrutinizing our business with laser focus.  

  

Primary responsibilities of System Development Engineer include automation and tool development, troubleshooting and diagnosing systemic and infrastructure issues, fixing production software issues, developing monitoring solutions, performing software maintenance and configuration, implementing the fix for internally developed code (Perl, Ruby, Java), performing SQL queries, updating, tracking and resolving technical challenges. Responsibilities also include working alongside development on Amazon Corporate and Divisional Software projects, updating/enhancing our current software, automation of support processes and documentation of our systems.  

  

The ideal candidate must be detail oriented, have superior verbal and written communication skills, strong organizational skills, able to juggle multiple tasks at once, able to work independently and can maintain professionalism under pressure. You must be able to identify problems before they happen and implement solutions that detect and prevent outages. You must be able to accurately prioritize projects, make sound judgments, work to improve the customer experience, and get the right things done.  

We are a group that has fun at work while driving incredible customer, business, and environmental impact. We are backed by a strong leadership group dedicated to operational excellence that empowers a reasonable work\-life balance. As an established, experienced team, we offer the scope and support needed for substantial career growth.  

  

Amazon is earth’s most customer\-centric company and through WW R\&R, the earth is our customer too. Come join us and innovate with the Amazon Worldwide Returns \& ReCommerce team!

* Experience in automating, deploying, and supporting large\-scale infrastructure
* Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C\+\+, C\#, Rust

title: Embedded System Engineer
description:
**Company Description**  
RAKwireless is a leading innovator in the Internet of Things (IoT) industry, dedicated to simplifying design complexities and accelerating time\-to\-market through its modular IoT solutions. Established in 2014 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the company operates R\&D centers in Beijing and Xi'an and maintains strategic partnerships across Asia, Europe, and the Americas.  
Driven by its "IoT Made Easy" philosophy, RAKwireless delivers high\-performance, energy\-efficient, and easy\-to\-deploy solutions for developers, system integrators, and IoT solution providers across a wide range of industries. Through its innovative hardware components and unified software ecosystem, RAKwireless aims to eliminate connectivity and interoperability barriers, empowering both emerging and established markets.

**Job Summary:**  
We are looking for a Embedded Systems Engineer to join our team to support customer deployments, proof\-of\-concept (POC) builds, and field testing for our modular IoT hardware ecosystem. In this role, you will work closely with hardware built on the RAKwireless ecosystem (core microcontrollers, wireless modules, and sensor boards). Your main goal will be to own technical troubleshooting, build practical demonstrations, run field coverage tests, and create comprehensive technical documentation. Ultimately serving as a key technical resource and reducing routine operational dependencies on senior SMEs.

​**Requirements**

***Experience:***Min 1 year of on paper experience is required.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Troubleshooting \& Support: Reproduce, analyze, and troubleshoot customer\-reported hardware, firmware, and integration issues in lab environments.
* POCs \& Demos: Design, build, and deliver functional Proofs\-of\-Concept (POCs) and technical demonstrations using the RAKwireless WisBlock platform and related sensor/communication modules.
* Field Testing \& Deployment: Conduct on\-site and field tests to evaluate wireless coverage, range, power consumption, and reliability across various deployment scenarios (e.g., LoRaWAN, BLE, Cellular).
* Documentation \& Knowledge Base: Document engineering results, field test data, and integration steps as technical reference guides, application notes, and case studies.
* SME Offloading: Take ownership of standard hardware/firmware queries to streamline customer support and significantly reduce routine support burdens on core SMEs.

***Key Qualifications \& Requirements:***

* Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Electronics \& Telecommunication Engineering, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands\-on Hardware Experience: 1\) Practical experience working with modular development kits, LPWAN/IoT platforms preferred. 2\) Familiarity with micro\-controllers (e.g.,STM32, ESP32,) and sensor integration (I2C, SPI, UART, ADC).
* Wireless Technologies: Good understanding of LPWAN protocols (LoRa/LoRaWAN), Wi\-Fi, BLE, or Cellular IoT.
* Firmware \& Software: Proficiency in C / C\+\+ (Arduino IDE, STM32CubeIDE, PlatformIO) and introductory scripting tools (e.g., Python) for testing and data logging.
* Technical Debugging: Experience with electronic debugging tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers) and board\-level troubleshooting.
* Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal technical communication skills to document case studies and interact clearly with both internal teams and external customers.
* Experience with network/protocol analyzers (e.g., Wireshark) or LoRaWAN Network Servers (ChirpStack, The Things Network).
* Basic understanding of PCB layout/schematics (KiCad, LTspice) to assist in root\-cause analysis.

**Role: Data Conversion, Migration and Cleansing Manager**
 The Data Conversion, Migration and Cleansing manager is a senior‑level role within the Finance Data Office (FDO) Data Management team. The role is accountable for leading large‑scale data cleansing, conversion, and migration activities to support enterprise ERP transformations across highly complex SAP landscapes, ensuring data readiness for SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA conversion through proactive remediation of legacy data ahead of extraction, load, and cutover.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Lead end‑to‑end data cleansing, conversion, and migration readiness for SAP ECC to S/4HANA programs in a large Oil \& Gas enterprise
* Own pre‑conversion data assessment, profiling, remediation, and validation to ensure data is fit for migration into S/4
* Drive cleansing and conversion readiness across complex Procurement data domains, including:
* Supplier Master, Business Partner
* Purchasing data, Procurement Finance data, bank data
* Intercompany and site‑specific supplier structures
* Material Master data
* Apply deep Procurement domain knowledge to understand end‑to‑end business processes, data usage, and downstream impacts during migration
* Leverage good solid understanding of Finance and Material Management (MM) to manage cross‑domain dependencies and data integration risks
* Act as a Syniti subject‑matter lead, using the platform for data profiling, cleansing, validation, reconciliation, exception handling, and migration readiness reporting
* Define and drive cleansing and conversion strategy, scope, prioritisation, and sequencing aligned to migration waves and program achievements
* Partner closely with Technology and Migration teams on:
* Field mappings and transformation logic
* Mock loads, reconciliation cycles, defect analysis, and cutover planning
* Make informed, risk‑based decisions on what data must be cleansed in legacy ECC versus addressed through migration or transformation logic
* Operate confidently across highly fragmented and interdependent data landscapes, including multiple SAP ECC instances, SAP MDG, S/4HANA, and interfacing systems
* Anticipate and manage cross‑object, cross‑system, and cross‑process dependencies across Procurement, Finance, and MM domains
* Independently lead conversations with senior business and technology stakeholders, including Senior level leaders
* Be assertive, confident, and evidence‑based in challenging scope, timelines, sequencing, resourcing, and remediation decisions
* Translate complex data issues into clear business, financial, audit, and cutover risks, enabling timely leadership decisions
* Own and execute high‑volume mass data updates via SAP MDG, enforcing strict controls, approvals, and validations to protect data integrity in a complex ERP landscape.
* Personally lead and review data analysis, profiling, reconciliation, and root‑cause investigations
* Guide teams on where to focus cleansing effort for maximum conversion, business, and risk‑reduction impact
* Provide clear, fact‑based status reporting and escalation to senior forums
* Ensure appropriate documentation, approvals, traceability, and audit readiness throughout the conversion lifecycle


**Essential Qualification And Experience**
* 13\+ years’ experience in Data Management, Data Conversion, or ERP Data Migration roles
* Proven delivery of ECC → S/4HANA data conversion in large, complex organisations
* Deep Procurement domain expertise with solid understanding of supplier and purchasing data structures
* Good working knowledge of Finance and SAP Material Management (MM)
* Critical working knowledge of Syniti or other similar tools for data cleansing and migration
* Strong analytical approach with willingness to be hands‑on
* Demonstrated ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and drive decision

title: Business Domain Data Steward
description:
Job Title
   

  

 Business Domain Data Steward
   

  

**Job Description**
**Business Domain Data Steward \| Pune, India\| Full\-time**
 If you are passionate about making data accessible, reliable, secure, and actionable to support data\-driven decision\-making within the Vanderlande Sell \& Deliver Value Chain, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.
   

  

**Your Role**
 As a Data Steward within the Project Execution domain, you will play a key role in ensuring high\-quality, trustworthy data is available to the right stakeholders at the right time. This role combines technical expertise with business understanding and offers the opportunity to collaborate closely with fellow Data Stewards, data engineers, data modelers, visualization specialists, subject matter experts, and business stakeholders across the Vanderlande Data Ecosystem.
   

  

 You will be responsible for identifying data sources, maintaining data mappings within the data catalog, and validating, accepting, and governing data products that support analytics and business insights.
   

  

 Join our highly motivated, collaborative, and performance\-driven Sell \& Deliver Data Team and contribute to advancing Vanderlande’s data\-driven transformation journey.
   

  

**What You Will Do/Key Responsibilities**
**Data Governance (30%)**
* Define, maintain, optimize, enforce, and monitor data policies, processes, procedures, and business rules across the Sell \& Deliver Value Chain.
* Contribute to the overall data governance strategy, including policies and guiding principles.
* Support the Sell \& Deliver Data Team with structured data management approaches, including data\-to\-source mapping and data assessments.
* Define and align fit\-for\-purpose data delivery requirements with Product Managers, Analytics teams, and Business Domain Owners.
* Participate in the Data Steward community led by the Executive Data Steward to ensure cross\-domain alignment.
* Collaborate with Data Stewards across other business domains to align business rules and governance standards.
* Maintain business metadata and data dictionaries within Microsoft Purview.
* Own and manage domain\-specific data products, including authorizations and access management.


**Data Quality Management (50%)**
* Oversee data streams and datasets within the business domain and coordinate improvements with other domain Data Stewards through the Data Governance Council.
* Define data quality acceptance criteria, critical data elements, KPIs, and corresponding quality targets.
* Implement workflows, monitoring mechanisms, and data quality KPIs aligned with the Vanderlande Data Ecosystem vision.
* Support internal data consumers in investigating and resolving data\-related issues end\-to\-end.
* Drive timely and cost\-effective resolution of data quality issues while considering agreed service levels between Central Analytics and business domains.
* Implement and manage end\-to\-end data quality checks across all data products within the Sell \& Deliver scope.
* Proactively investigate and resolve data quality issues in Databricks environments.
* Manage data pipelines and authorizations supporting dashboards and downstream applications.


**Data Exploration \& Enablement (20%)**
* Support the development and enhancement of Business Data Products and Source Data Products in collaboration with the Central Data \& Analytics Organization (CDAO) and the Sell \& Deliver Data Team.
* Perform data\-to\-source mapping activities together with the CDAO Data Modelling Team and subject matter experts.
* Identify and implement innovative approaches for data quality validation within the Project Execution domain.
* Ensure the Data Product Catalog remains updated and aligned with evolving business requirements.
* Promote data literacy and awareness across Vanderlande Service operations.


**What You Bring**
* Overall 8\-10 years of experience, 3–5 years of experience in Data \& Analytics.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder management skills across data producers, architects, engineers, and consumers.
* Exposure to or strong affinity with Service Domain operations in an Agile environment.
* Experience with Data Governance, Data Modelling, Data Analytics, and/or Data Visualization.
* Familiarity with tools and platforms such as
+ Microsoft Azure
+ Databricks \& Unity Catalog
+ Microsoft Purview
+ Power BI
+ Qlik Sense
+ SAFe Agile
+ DevOps

* Beginner to intermediate proficiency in SQL and Python/PySpark.
* Ability to quickly understand business processes within Life Cycle Service Delivery and related Vanderlande domains.
* Strong awareness of data consumers, personas, and business needs.
* Ability to proactively improve data literacy within the organization.


**About Vanderlande**
 Vanderlande makes automated systems that handle baggage at airports and sort parcels in logistics networks around the world. At airports, our technology manages the complete bag journey from check\-in and security screening through to the reclaim belt. In parcel logistics, our systems power the networks that get packages to customers' doors.
   

  

 At Vanderlande, you will find the space to aspire, to grow, and to achieve something that matters, with people who bring out the best in each other.
   

  

**Website** 
 www.vanderlande.com
   

  

**What We Offer**
 Working at Vanderlande comes with the support and space to grow, achieve, and enjoy the journey. Here is what that looks like in practice
   

  

* Competitive Salary Package
* 30 days of annual leave (pro\-rated from the start of the financial year), including
+ 22 paid leave days
+ 8 sick/casual leave days
+ Applicable government holidays

* Flexible and hybrid working model that promotes work\-life balance.
* Access to Vanderlande Academy and a wide range of learning and development programs to enhance your skills
* Comprehensive medical insurance coverage, including parental coverage
* Opportunities to participate in diverse Vanderlande communities, networks, and employee initiatives
* Opportunity to collaborate globally.


**How We Work**
 We work by three values Every day better, We care, and Team play. In practice, this means we drive customer success, lead with transparency, celebrate what we achieve together, and do what we say.
   

  

**Ready to apply?**
 Are you interested in this position? Apply directly via our careers page with your CV/Resume.
   

  

**Diversity \& inclusion**
 Vanderlande is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. Qualified applicants will be considered without regards to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.

title: Data & Reporting Specialist
description:

Logical, structured approach to problem solving. **Why join us?**
 This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
 If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test

**The Opportunity**
 ACA believes that we can deliver the world’s best GRC software to our blue\-chip financial services client base of over 3500 firms. We are seeking top talent to join us in our journey to build and deliver “The Salesforce of Compliance”. Compliance Officers in finance have been stuck in the past, with inefficient, manual effort driving their compliance programs. ACA’s ComplianceAlpha is deployed at 800\+ clients, with more added daily, to help modernize that. We are investing significantly to drive technology adoption among our clients.
   

  

 The SDET role is responsible for the development and delivery of an automation\-first test suite for our ComplianceAlpha products. Each SDET will be part of a geo\-located agile product team, and will provide guidance to the team during planning and refinement as well as execute on the plan during the sprint.
   

  

 We are looking for an imaginative self\-starter with a passion for great software and a curiosity for developing test automation solutions that drive exceptional quality and productivity. Only motivated problem solvers willing to take the initiative and demonstrate consistent follow\-through need apply. Qualified candidates will have hands\-on experience building automated tests and a drive to keep growing their skills.
   

  

**What To Expect Day To Day**
 As a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) on the Connectors team, you’ll help ensure the reliability of data pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of data from platforms such as Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom, Bloomberg, and other enterprise systems.
   

  

 On a typical day, you will:
   

  

  

* Work alongside a highly collaborative and talented engineering team.
* Design, develop, and execute automated functional tests to ensure the reliability and quality of our data pipelines.
* Collaborate with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into effective test coverage.
* Investigate failures, identify root causes, and help improve the overall quality of our platform.
* Explore and adopt new testing techniques, tools, and automation strategies.
* Expand your Python expertise while working with modern data engineering technologies.
* Participate in manual validation and release testing during production release cycles when needed.


**Required Skills**
**Skills and attributes for success**
* Curious, lifelong learner who is excited to develop new skills and explore new technologies.
* Passionate about software quality, automation, and continuous improvement.
* At least 2 years of experience developing software in Python.
* Experience developing automated test pipelines for Python\-based ETL processes.
* Experience consuming REST APIs using Python.
* Working knowledge of asynchronous Python (asyncio) and strategies for testing asynchronous code.
* Experience translating business requirements into automated functional tests.


**Nice to have**
* Experience developing automated tests for Apache Airflow pipelines.
* Experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL.
* Experience testing data\-intensive or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with AWS services commonly used in data pipelines.


**What We Look For**
 We are interested in innovative technology professionals with strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends in the industry. If you have a genuine passion for new technologies and transforming an entire industry, this role may be for you. A BE or B\-Tech in computer Science, or equivalent is a great preference.
   

  

**What Working At ACA Offers**
 We offer a competitive compensation package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to our business. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options as well as a flexible work environment. You’ll also be granted time off for designated ACA Paid Holidays, Summer Fridays, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
   

  

**Plus, we offer:**
* Continuous learning: You will develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We will provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We will give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You will be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.


**Why join our team?**
 We are the leading governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) advisor in financial services. When you join ACA, you'll become part of a team whose unique combination of talent includes the industry's largest team of former regulators, compliance professionals, legal professionals, and GIPS® standards verifiers in the industry, along with practitioners in cybersecurity, ESG, and regulatory technology.
   

  

 Our team enjoys an entrepreneurial work environment by offering innovative and tailored solutions for our clients. We encourage creative thinking and making the most of your experience at ACA by offering multiple career paths. We foster a culture of growth by focusing on continuous learning through inquiry and curiosity, and transparency. If you’re ready to be part of an award\-winning, global team of thoughtful, talented, and committed professionals, you’ve come to the right place.
   

  

**More About ACA**
 ACA was founded in 2002 by four former SEC regulators and one former state regulator. The founders saw a need for investment advisers to receive expert guidance on existing and new regulations.
   

  

 Over the years, ACA has grown both organically and by acquisition to expand our GRC business and technology solutions. Our services now include GIPS standards verification, cybersecurity and technology risk, regulatory technology, ESG advisory, AML and financial crimes, financial and regulatory reporting, and Mirabella for establishing EU operations.
   

  

**What We Commit To**
 ACA is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity. We conduct our business without regard to actual or perceived age, race, color, religion, disability, caregiver, marital or partnership status, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), ancestry, national origin and citizenship, sex, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, sexual and reproductive health decisions, military or veteran status, creed, genetic predisposition, carrier status or any other category protected by federal, state and local law.
   

  

 ACA is firmly committed to a policy of nondiscrimination, which applies to recruiting, hiring, placement, promotions, training, discipline, terminations, layoffs, recall, transfers, leaves of absence, compensation and all other terms and conditions of employment.
   

  

 Here at ACA, we have created a variety of programs to promote ACA’s culture of inclusivity and work hard to ensure that all our employees have an equal opportunity to contribute to ACA and feel that ACA is exactly where they belong.

title: Senior Engineer, Systems Engineering - Embedded Systems & PLC Controls
description:
**Job Title:**


Senior Engineer, Systems Engineering \- Embedded Systems \& PLC Controls**Job Description:**

**Senior****Embedded****Software/Firmware Engineer – Embedded Systems \& PLC Controls**

**Position Summary**


We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Software/Firmware Engineer to develop, integrate, and support embedded software, firmware, and PLC\-based control systems for industrial and electromechanical products used in semiconductor manufacturing. The ideal candidate will have strong embedded C/C\+\+ development experience along with practical knowledge of real\-time control systems, industrial automation, and PLC integration.


This role will support product development and sustaining engineering from concept through commercialization. The engineer will collaborate with electrical, mechanical, systems, manufacturing, quality, and product teams to translate requirements into reliable designs; develop, test, debug, qualify, and document solutions; support hardware bring\-up and system integration; and resolve field and manufacturing issues through structured root\-cause analysis.


The primary focus is embedded firmware and system integration. PLC, HMI, and SCADA experience is important, but the successful candidate is not expected to be an expert in every platform or protocol listed below.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Design, develop, test, and maintain** embedded firmware for microcontroller\- and processor\-based systems using C/C\+\+.
* **Develop low\-level drivers**, communication stacks, middleware, and application software for embedded products.
* **Implement and optimize** real\-time control functions, including task scheduling, interrupt handling, state machines, timing, fault handling, and diagnostics.
* **Integrate embedded controllers** with PLCs, sensors, actuators, motors, drives, instrumentation, and industrial networks.
* **Implement, integrate, and troubleshoot** CAN, RS\-232/422/485, UART, SPI, I²C, USB, Ethernet, and TCP/IP communications.
* **Partner with electrical engineers** to bring up and validate new hardware platforms using JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and related equipment.
* **Translate product** **needs** into functional and non\-functional software requirements, interface specifications, architecture, timing and memory constraints, and verification criteria.
* **Create and maintain technical documentation**, including requirements, architecture descriptions, interface documents, process flows, state\-machine diagrams, test plans, test reports, release notes, and troubleshooting guides.
* **Develop unit, integration, regression**, hardware\-in\-the\-loop, and system\-level tests; create tools and scripts that improve automation, repeatability, diagnostic coverage, and data analysis.
* **Participate in architecture, design, and code reviews**; apply coding standards, version control, issue tracking, configuration management, and secure development practices.
* **Support stage\-gate and New Product Introduction** activities from concept and prototype through design verification, validation, qualification, release, and transfer to manufacturing.
* **Support sustaining engineering** by troubleshooting software, firmware, hardware\-interface, manufacturing, and field issues; perform root\-cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
* **Collaborate with domestic and international engineering teams**, product management, manufacturing, quality, customers, suppliers, and external development partners.
* **Estimate effort**, identify technical and schedule risks, communicate tradeoffs, and take ownership of assigned work through completion.
**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 5\+ years of professional experience developing embedded software or firmware.
* Strong programming skills in C and C\+\+ for embedded systems.
* Hands\-on experience with RTOS concepts, embedded hardware architecture, interrupts, concurrency, timing, memory, and real\-time constraints.
* Experience developing low\-level drivers and integrating peripheral interfaces such as SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, and RS\-485\.
* Experience developing or integrating at least one industrial communication protocol or control network.
* Experience with Git or similar version\-control systems, code review, defect tracking, and controlled software release practices.
* Experience qualifying and validating software against written specifications through unit, integration, and system\-level testing.
* Ability to read schematics and troubleshoot embedded hardware and firmware interfaces using standard laboratory and debug equipment.
* Ability to create clear requirements, design documents, interface specifications, test plans, test reports, and troubleshooting documentation.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to prioritize work, manage multiple assignments, and deliver in a fast\-paced product\-development and sustaining environment.
**Nice to Have**

*Candidates are not expected to have every item listed below. These capabilities are considered nice to have and may broaden the candidate’s fit based on the products and technologies supported by the team.*

* Experience programming or integrating industrial PLC platforms such as Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or CODESYS.
* Experience developing or maintaining HMI and SCADA applications.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols such as CANopen, Modbus, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, EtherCAT, or OPC UA.
* Embedded Linux experience, including Yocto, Buildroot, board\-support packages, device drivers, or system services.
* **Develop and maintain PLC software** using one or more major platforms such as Rockwell/Allen\-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff, or CODESYS.
* **Create, integrate, and support** HMI and SCADA interfaces for industrial equipment and engineering test systems.
* Working knowledge of PLC programming or PLC\-to\-embedded\-system integrati
* Motor\-control experience involving stepper, BLDC, or servo drives, encoder feedback, PID tuning, or motion profiles.
* Digital signal\-processing experience, including filtering, sampling, high\-resolution ADCs, or sensor signal conditioning.
* Familiarity with semiconductor\-equipment communication standards such as SECS/GEM or HSMS.
* Experience with Python, C\#, automated test frameworks, CI/CD, GitHub Actions, containers, or hardware\-in\-the\-loop testing.
* FPGA/CPLD development or HDL familiarity.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity frameworks such as SEMI E187/E188 or IEC 62443\.
* Experience supporting semiconductor equipment or other regulated, high\-reliability industrial products.
* Experience with stage\-gate development and New Product Introduction.
* Master’s degree in a relevant engineering or computer\-science discipline.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:

**Contract type:** Full\-time and open\-ended

**Salary:** Delhi – 2,100,000 \- 2,700,000 INR (Depends upon experience)

**Location:** Delhi, India (Hybrid)

**Application closing date:** 30th September 2026

 *If we receive a high volume of applications, we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

 **About the Job**

  

The Senior Data Product Engineer role has a significant impact on the organization by ensuring that our data infrastructure is scalable, secure, and aligned with strategic priorities. This role enables reliable access to high\-quality data, supports the development of data products, and improves the organization’s ability to make timely, evidence\-based decisions. By strengthening our Azure\-based platform (Cotton Cloud), the role reduces data silos, enhances operational efficiency, and lays the technical foundation for future use cases. It also fosters collaboration across functions, drives adoption of data tools, and contributes to a stronger, more mature data culture across the organization.

 **The Challenge**

  

Looking ahead to 2030, we are targeting reducing GHG emissions from cotton production by half, big cuts in synthetic pesticide use, improve soil health across our network, improve farm income and support women’s empowerment among farmers and farm workers.

 **Responsibilities**

  

We are seeking a motivated **Senior Data Engineer** to join our **ITOS Function**. In this role, you will be responsible for.

* **Design, Develop, and Maintain Data Infrastructure**  

Build and maintain scalable, secure, and efficient data pipelines, storage layers, and integrations on Azure. Ensure the platform can support both current reporting needs and future analytical use cases.
* **Technical leadership, Data enablement \& Literacy:**  

Provide technical direction and establish engineering best practices across the data team. Educate data analysts and other data consumers on data models, definitions, and usage best practices to maximize the value extracted from organizational data
* **Stakeholder Collaboration and Solution Design**  

Work closely with data analysts, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand data needs, co\-create and refine high\-quality datasets that directly power critical business dashboards and analytical tools
* Consultant collaboration: Act as primary point of contact for external consultants, overseeing project development, ensuring adherence to technical standards, and facilitating timely issue resolution
* **Platform Visibility and Adoption**  

Promote internal awareness and usage of Cotton Cloud by supporting onboarding, documentation, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.
* **Governance, Quality, and Compliance**  

Ensure the platform adheres to data governance standards, including security, privacy, data quality, and access controls.
* **Continuous Improvement and Innovation**  

Identify opportunities to improve system performance, adopt new tools, or enhance platform capabilities to meet evolving business needs.

 **Experience**

 **Education \& Experience:*** A degree in Computer Science or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
* At least 3 years of relevant data engineering experience.
* Proficiency in ETL, SQL, and a programming language such as Java, C\#, or C\+\+.
* Hands\-on experience with Azure Data Factory, GitHub CI/CD, and relational/NoSQL databases.
* A track record of building and delivering data solutions on Azure.
* Understanding of BI tools and practices, and ideally experience with Power BI **and** Salesforce.

**Skills \& Competencies (Outcome\-Driven)*** Data\-Driven Decision\-Making: Uses analytics to optimise workflows and improve efficiency.
* Process Improvement: Identifies gaps and implements solutions that enhance performance.
* Effective Communication: Tailors messages to engage, inform, and influence varied audiences.

* Collaborative Working: Partners across functions and geographies to deliver results.

**Technical competencies (Role\-Specific, Outcome\-Linked)****1**. **Advanced Cloud Data Engineering (Azure)*** Expertise: Deep knowledge of Azure services such as Data Factory, Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, Azure SQL, and monitoring tools.
* Contribution to Results: Enables the design of scalable, reliable, and secure data pipelines that support operational reporting and advanced analytics.


2\. **Data Modeling \& Pipeline Development*** Expertise: Proficiency in data modeling (dimensional and normalized), ELT processes, and performance optimization.
* Contribution to Results: Delivers clean, structured, high\-performance datasets that reduce time to insight and improve decision\-making quality.


3\. **Programming and Automation*** Expertise: Strong skills in SQL, Python or PySpark, and infrastructure\-as\-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Bicep).
* Contribution to Results: Automates data workflows and infrastructure provisioning, improving reliability, reproducibility, and efficiency.


4\. **Data Governance and Security Awareness*** Expertise: Understanding of data privacy, security, access control, and compliance principles.
* Contribution to Results: Ensures platform compliance with governance standards, reducing risk and supporting responsible data use.


5\. **Stakeholder Collaboration*** Expertise: Ability to engage with cross\-functional teams and translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Contribution to Results: Aligns platform development with real\-world use cases, increasing data adoption and user satisfaction.

 **What we offer**


Hybrid working – One week in six weeks in the Delhi office


The opportunity to work from anywhere in the world for up to one month per year

Continuous learning and development

The opportunity to make your mark and make a difference.

Send us your CV (2 pages maximum) and a brief cover letter (1\-page maximum) by or before **30\.09\.2026** via the application link.

 Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating

 Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next \- together!
 



 We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join our growing data team. description:
🚀 We're are Hiring @Algo8AI
 



  





**Role:** 




**Data Engineer — Data Platform \& Pipelines** 




**Lake, canonical model and data quality** 




  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Noida \| Hybrid (4 days/week in office)
 



 💼

 5–7 years

 Permanent \| Algo8 Payroll
 



 👤

 Tech Lead
 



 ⏱️
 **Joining:** 
 Early joiners / short notice preferred
 



  





 You will build and own the
 **spine of the programme** 
 — the on\-premises data platform, the canonical model that everything lands into, and the quality framework that determines whether the foundation can be trusted.
 



  





**About Algo8** 




  





 Algo8 is an industrial and manufacturing AI firm. We work inside plants and R\&D centres — with engineers, scientists and plant teams — building the data foundations and AI capabilities that enable industrial organisations to make better decisions. Our work is hands\-on and close to the client.
 



  





**The Engagement** 




  





 You will join a multi\-year programme with the R\&D centre of excellence of a large Indian manufacturer.
 



 The centre holds four decades of engineering knowledge — design records, formulations, laboratory results, test data, reports and studies — spread across enterprise systems, departmental databases, local servers and document archives.
 



 The programme recovers that knowledge into a single governed foundation, connects it to manufacturing context, and then validates where engineering intelligence can be built on top of it.
 



**This is a data engineering programme first. The AI comes later, and only where the evidence supports it.** 




**The solution is on\-premises.** 




 Because of the proprietary nature of new product development, this foundation is being built inside the client's own infrastructure.
 



**If your experience is entirely on managed cloud services, this will not be the right fit.** 




  





**What You Will Own** 




  





**The platform** 




 Stand up and operate the on\-premises data lake and processing layer — storage, compute, orchestration and access control.
 



**The canonical model** 




 Work with engineers and business analysts to design a shared data model across engineering and manufacturing domains, then keep it coherent as new sources land.
 



**Ingestion pipelines** 




 Build the pipelines that bring recovered and synchronised data into the foundation, with lineage from source to consumption.
 



**Data quality** 




 Define and implement quality thresholds per source. Each estate has to pass an acceptance gate before it is declared complete — you own the evidence behind that.
 



**Enabling everyone else** 




 The integration and document engineers land data into your platform. Analytics and validation work builds on top of it. Making both easy is part of the job.
 



**The Expected Stack** 




 The architecture is being finalised with the client. We expect to work with an on\-premises stack along these lines, or close equivalents:
 



 •
 **Distributed processing and query** 
 — Spark, Trino or equivalent
 



 •
 **On\-premises object storage** 
 — MinIO, HDFS or equivalent
 



 •
 **Relational stores** 
 — PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server
 



 •
 **Orchestration** 
 — Airflow or equivalent
 



 •
 **Streaming and change capture** 
 — Kafka, Debezium or equivalent
 



*We are more interested in whether you have run this class of system on your own infrastructure than in which specific tools you have used.* 




  





**What We Need From You** 




  





 •
 **Strong on\-premises data platform experience** 
 — you have built and run distributed processing and storage on infrastructure you or your organisation managed, not only on managed cloud services.
 



 •
 **Data modelling depth** 
 — you can design a canonical model across messy sources and defend the decisions behind it.
 



 •
 **Production pipeline engineering** 
 — Spark or equivalent, Python, strong SQL, and orchestration with Airflow or similar.
 



 •
 **Data quality and governance in practice** 
 — validation frameworks, lineage and reconciliation. Not as theory, but as something you have actually implemented.
 



 •
 **Clear communication** 
 — you will explain to non\-technical stakeholders why data is or is not ready, and that conversation matters as much as the pipeline.
 



  





**Useful, Not Essential** 




  





 • Manufacturing or industrial data experience
 



 • Kafka, Debezium or other change\-data\-capture tooling
 



 • Metadata catalogue and governance tooling
 



 • Experience defining acceptance criteria on a client programme
 



  





**How You Will Work** 




  





 • Based in
 **Noida, hybrid — four days a week in office** 
 .
 



 • Reporting to the
 **Tech Lead** 
 for the programme, alongside a large on\-site business analyst team who own requirements gathering and client expectations.
 



 • Occasional travel to client plant and R\&D locations as the work requires.
 



 • You will be working with an existing enterprise estate that is not fully documented.
 



**Discovery is part of the job — expect to map what is actually there before you design against it.** 




  





**Who This Role Is Not For** 




  





 We would rather be direct than waste your time. This role is probably not a fit if:
 



  





 • Your data engineering experience is entirely on managed cloud services and you have never sized, deployed or operated infrastructure yourself.
 



 • You are a BI or reporting developer — dashboards, SQL views and reports — rather than someone who has built and owned pipelines.
 



 • Your work has been drag\-and\-drop ETL tooling without engineering underneath it.
 



 • You are an application or backend developer whose data work has been incidental.
 



 • You have never worked with enterprise systems such as
 **ERP, PLM or MES** 
 .
 



  





**Working at Algo8** 




 • You will build capability that outlasts this engagement. What you learn here is directly reusable across our industrial client base.
 



 • Small senior team, high ownership, and direct access to client engineering leadership.
 



  





**Applying** 




  





**We need this team in place early.** 




 Please tell us your
 **notice period** 
 when you apply — candidates who can join immediately or at short notice will be prioritised.
 



  





 Our process is a
 **CV review, a short written assignment, and interviews.** 




  





**If you have the experience to build and own an on\-premises data platform from the ground up, we'd like to hear from you.** 




 You can share your CVs at: shruti.sinha@algo8\.ai

title: Integration Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** 
 Integration Engineer
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon (Full\-Time, 100% In\-Office)
   

  

**Experience Required:** 
 2\+ Years
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
   

  

**Reports To:** 
 Tech Lead
   

  

**Role Summary**
 We are building the Supply Chain Operating System for India's manufacturers and distributors that run their operations on homegrown ERPs but lack real\-time visibility into inventory health, order flow, or logistics performance. Our system sits on top of existing ERPs and WMSs, creates a unified operational data model, and turns inventory data into better decisions through an intelligent pooling of AI agents and deterministic models.
   

  

 As an Integration Engineer, you will own the bridge between customer systems and our intelligence platform. You will turn ERP/WMS data into a clean, timely, and trusted operational model through reusable connectors, mappings, validations, and implementation discipline.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Build and maintain reusable ERP, accounting, and WMS connectors, starting with priority systems such as Tally/TallyPrime, ERPNext, Zoho Inventory, and WMS platforms.
* Map source masters and transactions (SKUs, warehouses, inventory positions, movements, orders, GRNs, transfers, and batches) into a canonical operational data model.
* Implement API, webhook, polling, and file\-based ingestion with incremental sync, retries, idempotency, conflict handling, rate limits, and secure credential management.
* Create validation and reconciliation routines for item masters, UOMs, inventory positions, batches/lots, and transaction history; work with AI/Data Science on freshness and quality scoring.
* Build connector\-health monitoring for sync status, lag, errors, and failed records; document mappings, edge cases, and support runbooks.
* Support pilot discovery, mapping workshops, test loads, UAT, and cutover; within 90 days, deliver an end\-to\-end staging integration and connector onboarding playbook.


**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* 2\+ years of experience in integration engineering, data engineering, ETL/ELT, implementation engineering, or ERP/WMS connector development.
* Strong SQL and data\-mapping fundamentals, including data lineage, entity resolution, and reconciliation.
* Hands\-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, webhooks, CSV/Excel feeds, auth mechanisms, and scheduled/incremental synchronization.
